{\n            id,\n            stage,\n            payload,\n            created_at: crate::clock::monotonic_ms(),\n            synced_at: None,\n            retry_count: 0,\n            status: QueueStatus::Pending,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Черга офлайн-операцій.\n///\n/// Використовує кільцевий буфер: при досягненні ліміту витісняє\n/// найстаріший запис зі статусом `Pending` або `Failed`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct OfflineQueue {\n    entries: Vec<QueueEntry>,\n    capacity: usize,\n    next_id: u64,\n    on_sync: Vec<fn(u64, bool)>,\n    gpu_cache: Vec<(String, Vec<u8>)>,\n    gossip_node: Option<dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipNode>,\n}\n\nimpl OfflineQueue {\n    /// Створити чергу з заданою місткістю.\n    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {\n        OfflineQueue {\n            entries: Vec::with_capacity(capacity.min(1)),\n            capacity: capacity.max(1),\n            next_id: 1,\n            on_sync: Vec::new(),\n            gpu_cache: Vec::new(),\n            gossip_node: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Attach a gossip node for event-driven communication.\n    /// When attached, the queue receives state sync events and\n    /// publishes sync results automatically.\n    pub fn attach_gossip(&mut self, bus: &mut dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipBus, name: &str) {\n        use dowiz_kernel::gossip::{GossipNode, GossipTopic};\n        let node = GossipNode::register(bus, name, &[\n            GossipTopic::StateSync,\n            GossipTopic::Resilience,\n            GossipTopic::Backup,\n        ]);\n        self.gossip_node = Some(node);\n    }\n\n    /// Process gossip events for this queue: drain pending messages\n    /// and update internal state accordingly.\n    pub fn process_gossip(&mut self, bus: &mut dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipBus) {\n        let Some(ref node) = self.gossip_node else { return; };\n        let msgs = node.drain(bus);\n        for msg in &msgs {\n            match msg.topic {\n                dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipTopic::Resilience => {\n                    // Parse resilience state — enter degraded mode if critical\n                    if let Ok(s) = std::str::from_utf8(&msg.payload) {\n                        if s.contains("deg=Critical") || s.contains("deg=Failed") {\n                            // Circuit breaker: reduce offline capacity\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipTopic::Backup => {\n                    // Backup triggers: persist pending entries\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Поточна глибина черги (telemetry).\n    pub fn queue_depth(&self) -> usize {\n        self.entries.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Simulate a sync operation before actually executing it.\n    ///\n    /// Uses the system predictor + resilience to predict whether\n    /// syncing a pending entry would succeed or fail. Returns\n    /// `(should_proceed, alternative_suggestion)`.\n    /// If `should_proceed` is false, try the alternative or wait.\n    ///\n    /// This method uses the gossip bus for event-driven communication:\n    /// it publishes a sync check request and reads the response from\n    /// the bus after processing. Falls back to direct predictor/resilience\n    /// calls when the bus is not available for synchronous operation.\n    pub fn simulate_sync(\n        &self,\n        entry: &QueueEntry,\n        _predictor: &dowiz_kernel::predictor::Predictor,\n        resilience: &mut dowiz_kernel::resilience::ResilienceManager,\n        bus: Option<&mut dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipBus>,\n    ) -> (bool, String) {\n        let queue_load = dowiz_kernel::sanitize_normalized(\n            self.entries.len() as f64 / self.capacity as f64\n        );\n        let retry_ratio = if entry.retry_count > 0 {\n            dowiz_kernel::sanitize_normalized(entry.retry_count as f64 / 5.0)\n        } else {\n            0.0\n        };\n\n        // Publish sync check event to gossip bus (async notification).\n        if let Some(bus) = bus {\n            bus.publish(\n                dowiz_kernel::gossip::GossipTopic::StateSync,\n                &dowiz_kernel::gossip::telemetry_payload("queue_load", queue_load),\n                dowiz_kernel::now_ms(),\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Feed predictor with current queue state for synchronous prediction.\n        // This requires us to own a Predictor, but we have &Predictor.\n        // Instead, use pre-computed metrics with resilience manager.\n        let avg_metric = queue_load.max(retry_ratio);\n        let strategy = resilience.record_outcome(\n            avg_metric,\n            dowiz_kernel::sanitize_normalized(retry_ratio * 0.5),\n            dowiz_kernel::sanitize_normalized(retry_ratio * 0.3),\n            dowiz_kernel::now_ms(),\n        );\n\n        let should_proceed =\n            resilience.level() < dowiz_kernel::resilience::DegradationLevel::Warning;\n        let suggestion = match strategy {\n dowiz_kernel::resilience::FailoverStrategy::CrystalOnly => "use_cached".into(),\n            dowiz_kernel::resilience::FailoverStrategy::StaticFallback => "store_locally".into(),\n            _ => "proceed".into(),\n        };\n        (should_proceed, suggestion)\n    }\n\n    /// Додати запис до черги. При переповненні витісняє найстаріший\n    /// Pending/Failed запис. Повертає `id` запису.\n    pub fn enqueue(&mut self, stage: OrderStage, payload: Vec<u8>) -> u64 {\n        crate::telemetry_count!("offline", "enqueue", 1);\n        if self.entries.len() >= self.capacity {\n            self.evict_one();\n        }\n        if self.entries.len() >= self.capacity {\n            self.evict_one();\n        }\n        let id = self.next_id;\n        self.next_id += 1;\n        self.entries.push(QueueEntry::new(id, stage, payload));\n        id\n    }\n\n    /// Синхронізувати всі pending запити. Викликає `sync_fn` для кожного.\n    /// Повертає (synced, failed).\n    pub fn sync_all<F>(&mut self, mut sync_fn: F) -> (usize, usize)\n    where\n        F: FnMut(&QueueEntry) -> Result<(), ()>,\n    {\n        let mut synced = 0usize;\n        let mut failed = 0usize;\n        for entry in self.entries.iter_mut() {\n            if entry.status != QueueStatus::Pending && entry.status != QueueStatus::Failed {\n                continue;\n            }\n            entry.status = QueueStatus::Syncing;\n            match sync_fn(entry) {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    entry.status = QueueStatus::Synced;\n                    entry.synced_at = Some(crate::clock::monotonic_ms());\n                    for &cb in &self.on_sync {\n                        cb(entry.id, true);\n                    }\n                    synced += 1;\n                }\n                Err(()) => {\n                    entry.retry_count += 1;\n                    entry.status = QueueStatus::Failed;\n                    for &cb in &self.on_sync {\n                        cb(entry.id, false);\n                    }\n                    failed += 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        (synced, failed)\n    }\n\n    /// Отримати всі записи з черги.\n    pub fn all(&self) -> &[QueueEntry] {\n        &self.entries\n    }\n\n    /// Отримати кількість pending + failed записів.\n    pub fn pending_count(&self) -> usize {\n        self.entries\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|e| e.status == QueueStatus::Pending || e.status == QueueStatus::Failed)\n            .count()\n    }\n\n    /// Очистити всі synced записи старші за `max_age_ms`.\n    pub fn clean(&mut self, max_age_ms: u64) {\n        let now = crate::clock::monotonic_ms();\n        self.entries.retain(|e| {\n            if e.status == QueueStatus::Synced {\n                if let Some(synced) = e.synced_at {\n                    if now.saturating_sub(synced) > max_age_ms {\n 4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/onboarding.rs	onboarding · 172 lines	//! P64 M7 — Implicit onboarding v1 (idle-field hints, no tutorial modal).\n//!\n//! BLUEPRINT-P64 §2 / §3.7. `HintPolicy` tracks per-intent `familiarity: u8`.\n//! When the field is SETTLED and the user has not yet demonstrated the surface's\n//! primary intent, the Composer overlays low-amplitude affordance HINT\n//! directives — gentle field perturbations expressing the next available intent,\n//! in the SAME field language as friction (§16.50). A hint retires once\n//! `familiarity[intent] >= HINT_MASTERY_THRESHOLD`. No modal, no text how-to.\n//!\n//! Hints are visual/audio ONLY: they never consume or reorder a real `Intent`\n//! (`hint_never_intercepts_real_input`), and appear only when settled\n//! (`hint_respects_settle`).\n\nuse crate::friction::HINT_MASTERY_THRESHOLD;\nuse crate::intent::Intent;\nuse crate::scene::SdfShape;\n\n/// A single intent's familiarity record.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]\npub struct Familiarity {\n    pub successes: u8,\n}\n\nimpl Familiarity {\n    pub fn mastered(&self) -> bool {\n        self.successes >= HINT_MASTERY_THRESHOLD\n    }\n}\n\n/// Small stable key for an intent kind we track hints for.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]\npub enum HintIntent {\n    OpenMenu,\n    OpenCart,\n    Confirm,\n}\n\nimpl HintIntent {\n    fn from_intent(intent: &Intent) -> Option<HintIntent> {\n        match intent {\n            Intent::Navigate(crate::intent::NavTarget::Menu)\n            | Intent::Command(crate::intent::CommandId::OpenMenu) => Some(HintIntent::OpenMenu),\n            Intent::Navigate(crate::intent::NavTarget::Cart)\n            | Intent::Command(crate::intent::CommandId::OpenCart) => Some(HintIntent::OpenCart),\n            Intent::Command(crate::intent::CommandId::ConfirmOrder) => Some(HintIntent::Confirm),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A low-amplitude affordance hint directive (in the SAME field language as\n/// friction — a gentle perturbation at the location that would express the next\n/// available intent). Visual/audio only.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub struct HintDirective {\n    pub intent: HintIntent,\n    pub shape: SdfShape,\n    pub amplitude: f32,\n}\n\n/// The onboarding policy. Holds per-intent familiarity. Persisted in the P66\n/// wallet by consumers (this module only owns the in-memory model + the rule).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct HintPolicy {\n    familiarity: std::collections::BTreeMap<HintIntent, Familiarity>,\n    /// The surface's primary intent (the one hinted first).\n    primary: HintIntent,\n}\n\nimpl HintPolicy {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        HintPolicy {\n            familiarity: std::collections::BTreeMap::new(),\n            primary: HintIntent::OpenMenu,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a successful performance of an intent (advances familiarity).\n    pub fn record_success(&mut self, intent: &Intent) {\n        if let Some(key) = HintIntent::from_intent(intent) {\n            let f = self.familiarity.entry(key).or_default();\n            f.successes = f.successes.saturating_add(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn familiarity_of(&self, key: HintIntent) -> Familiarity {\n        *self\n            .familiarity\n            .get(&key)\n            .unwrap_or(&Familiarity::default())\n    }\n\n    /// True iff the field is settled (no in-flight animation). The Composer asks\n    /// this before overlaying hints. (Caller owns the settle gate; we model it as\n    /// a passed-in boolean so the policy stays pure/testable.)\n    pub fn hints_for(&self, settled: bool, center: (f32, f32)) -> Vec<HintDirective> {\n        if !settled {\n            return Vec::new(); // hint_respects_settle\n        }\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        // Hint the primary intent if not yet mastered; then any other unmastered.\n        let consider = std::iter::once(self.primary)\n            .chain([HintIntent::OpenCart, HintIntent::Confirm].into_iter())\n            .filter(|k| !self.familiarity_of(*k).mastered());\n        for k in consider {\n            out.push(HintDirective {\n                intent: k,\n                shape: SdfShape::Circle {\n                    cx: center.0 as f64,\n                    cy: center.1 as f64,\n                    r: 0.6,\n                },\n                amplitude: 0.05, // low-amplitude, never distracting\n            });\n        }\n        out\n    }\n\n    /// A hint NEVER intercepts real input: resolving a user intent returns the\n    /// user's intent, not a hinted one. This helper is the contract — it returns\n    /// the user intent unchanged (proved by `hint_never_intercepts_real_input`).\n    pub fn resolve_user_intent(&self, user_intent: Intent) -> Intent {\n        user_intent\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::intent::{CommandId, Intent, NavTarget};\n\n    #[test]\n    fn onboarding_hint_present_then_decays() {\n        let mut policy = HintPolicy::new();\n        let center = (0.0f32, 0.0f32);\n\n        // Fresh profile, settled idle → ≥1 hint for the primary intent.\n        let hints = policy.hints_for(true, center);\n        assert!(\n            !hints.is_empty(),\n            "fresh profile must surface ≥1 hint on settled idle"\n        );\n        assert!(hints.iter().any(|h| h.intent == HintIntent::OpenMenu));\n\n        // After HINT_MASTERY_THRESHOLD successes of the primary intent, NO hint\n        // for it remains (it retired).\n        for _ in 0..HINT_MASTERY_THRESHOLD {\n            policy.record_success(&Intent::Navigate(NavTarget::Menu));\n        }\n        let hints2 = policy.hints_for(true, center);\n        assert!(\n            !hints2.iter().any(|h| h.intent == HintIntent::OpenMenu),\n            "primary hint must retire after mastery threshold"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn hint_never_intercepts_real_input() {\n        let policy = HintPolicy::new();\n        let user = Intent::Command(CommandId::ConfirmOrder);\n        // The user's real intent resolves to the user's intent, never the hinted one.\n        assert_eq!(policy.resolve_user_intent(user.clone()), user);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn hint_respects_settle() {\n        let policy = HintPolicy::new();\n        // A busy field (settled=false) shows no hints (no distraction mid-action).\n        assert!(policy.hints_for(false, (0.0, 0.0)).is_empty());\n        assert!(!policy.hints_for(true, (0.0, 0.0)).is_empty());\n    }\n}\n	1287	-1	-1		332af2ceb84f6171a148a0e595f97bfa2d56340cef561fff0156c84da6d9cb437c61a46dcc1fdc0f835493ef80d1df1dc3c59626b42c06e6e127fa2df70cf0c5dcaf7491cd1bac1196093808f6faf0d1d769944ee0be7265cc18e2e636ab6710f4f8fe9e68cad309d359ca8ce24cfeb0ee6d612ea6a54b2351006f4115252d73

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/oracle.rs	oracle · 387 lines	//! OracleSystem — dead reckoning + ETA для кур'єрської доставки.\n//!\n//! Зливає дані з акселерометра/гіроскопа (IMU) та GPS в єдину оцінку\n//! позиції девайсу. Коли GPS недоступний, використовує dead reckoning\n//! (подвійне інтегрування акселерометра) + гіроскоп для курсу.\n//!\n//! ETA рахується через `kernel::geo::eta_seconds_adaptive` з використанням\n//! згладженої швидкості з `CourierSpeedEma`.\n//!\n//! Ніколи не блокує рендер — усі сенсори опціональні.\n\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse dowiz_kernel::geo::{self, CourierSpeedEma};\n\n/// Семпл з акселерометра/гіроскопа.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct ImuSample {\n    pub ax: f32,\n    pub ay: f32,\n    pub az: f32,\n    pub gx: f32,\n    pub gy: f32,\n    pub gz: f32,\n    pub timestamp_us: u64,\n}\n\n/// GPS-фікс.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct GpsFix {\n    pub lat: f64,\n    pub lng: f64,\n    pub accuracy_m: f32,\n    pub speed_mps: Option<f32>,\n    pub timestamp_us: u64,\n}\n\n/// Поточна оцінка позиції девайсу.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct DeviceDisplacement {\n    pub estimated_lat: f64,\n    pub estimated_lng: f64,\n    pub bearing_deg: f32,\n    pub confidence: f32,\n}\n\nimpl DeviceDisplacement {\n    pub const fn unknown() -> Self {\n        DeviceDisplacement {\n            estimated_lat: 0.0,\n            estimated_lng: 0.0,\n            bearing_deg: 0.0,\n            confidence: 0.0,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Стан калібрування інерційного сенсора.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum CalibrationState {\n    Uncalibrated,\n    Calibrating,\n    Calibrated,\n}\n\n/// Oracle — інерційна навігація + GPS.\n///\n/// - IMU семпли накопичуються в кільцевому буфері (останні 100).\n/// - Dead reckoning: подвійне інтегрування акселерометра для позиції,\n///   гіроскоп для bearing.\n/// - GPS-фікси скидають дрейф і оновлюють `CourierSpeedEma`.\n/// - confidence = 1.0 після GPS, згасає з часом без фіксів.\npub struct OracleSystem {\n    imu_buffer: Vec<ImuSample>,\n    last_gps: Option<GpsFix>,\n    displacement: DeviceDisplacement,\n    speed_ema: CourierSpeedEma,\n    calibration: CalibrationState,\n    last_timestamp_us: u64,\n    velocity: (f64, f64),\n    route_version: u64,\n    // Telemetry counters\n    gps_fix_total: AtomicU64,\n    dr_freeze_count: AtomicU64,\n    imu_sample_total: AtomicU64,\n}\n\nimpl OracleSystem {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        OracleSystem {\n            imu_buffer: Vec::with_capacity(100),\n            last_gps: None,\n            displacement: DeviceDisplacement::unknown(),\n            speed_ema: CourierSpeedEma::new(),\n            calibration: CalibrationState::Uncalibrated,\n            last_timestamp_us: 0,\n            velocity: (0.0, 0.0),\n            route_version: 0,\n            gps_fix_total: AtomicU64::new(0),\n            dr_freeze_count: AtomicU64::new(0),\n            imu_sample_total: AtomicU64::new(0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість GPS-фіксів від початку життя системи (telemetry).\n    pub fn gps_fix_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.gps_fix_total.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість IMU-семплів у буфері (telemetry).\n    pub fn imu_buffer_len(&self) -> usize {\n        self.imu_buffer.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість IMU-семплів від початку (telemetry).\n    pub fn imu_sample_total(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.imu_sample_total.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Скільки разів dead reckoning заморожувався через низький confidence.\n    pub fn dr_freeze_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.dr_freeze_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Залити семпл з акселерометра/гіроскопа.\n    ///\n    /// Виконує dead reckoning: інтегрує акселерометр для швидкості та позиції,\n    /// гіроскоп — для bearing. Працює лише після калібрування.\n    pub fn ingest_imu(&mut self, sample: ImuSample) {\n        if self.calibration != CalibrationState::Calibrated {\n            if self.imu_buffer.len() < 50 {\n                self.imu_buffer.push(sample);\n                self.calibration = CalibrationState::Calibrating;\n                self.last_timestamp_us = sample.timestamp_us;\n                return;\n            }\n            self.calibration = CalibrationState::Calibrated;\n            self.imu_buffer.clear();\n        }\n\n        let dt_us = sample.timestamp_us.saturating_sub(self.last_timestamp_us);\n        self.last_timestamp_us = sample.timestamp_us;\n        if dt_us == 0 {\n            return;\n        }\n        let dt_s = dt_us as f64 / 1_000_000.0;\n\n        if self.imu_buffer.len() >= 100 {\n            self.imu_buffer.remove(0);\n        }\n        self.imu_buffer.push(sample);\n        self.imu_sample_total.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        crate::telemetry_count!("oracle", "imu_sample", 1);\n\n        self.displacement.confidence =\n            (self.displacement.confidence - 0.01).max(0.0);\n\n        // Dead reckoning: використовується тільки при confidence > DR_FREEZE.\n        // Нижче цього порогу позиція ЗАВМИРАЄ — дрейф надто високий,\n        // і подвійне інтегрування дасть хибні координати.\n        const DR_FREEZE: f32 = 0.1;\n        const METERS_PER_DEG_LAT: f64 = 111_320.0;\n\n        if self.displacement.confidence > DR_FREEZE {\n            let vx = self.velocity.0 + sample.ax as f64 * dt_s;\n            let vy = self.velocity.1 + sample.ay as f64 * dt_s;\n            // Обмежуємо швидкість: 30 м/с (~108 км/год) max — захист від шуму IMU.\n            let speed = (vx * vx + vy * vy).sqrt();\n            let clamped = if speed > 30.0 { 30.0 / speed } else { 1.0 };\n            self.velocity = (vx * clamped, vy * clamped);\n\n            let cos_lat = self.displacement.estimated_lat.to_radians().cos().max(0.01);\n            let dlat = self.velocity.0 * dt_s / METERS_PER_DEG_LAT;\n            let dlng = self.velocity.1 * dt_s / (METERS_PER_DEG_LAT * cos_lat);\n            self.displacement.estimated_lat += dlat;\n            self.displacement.estimated_lng += dlng;\n        } else {\n            // Confidence нижче порогу — зупиняємо DR, обнуляємо velocity.\n            self.dr_freeze_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n            self.velocity = (0.0, 0.0);\n        }\n\n        self.displacement.bearing_deg = (self.displacement.bearing_deg as f64\n            + sample.gz as f64 * dt_s * 57.2958) as f32 % 360.0;\n        if self.displacement.bearing_deg < 0.0 {\n            self.displacement.bearing_deg += 360.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Залити GPS-фікс.\n    ///\n    /// Скидає дрейф dead reckoning: позиція = GPS, confidence = 1.0.\n    /// Передає `speed_mps` в `CourierSpeedEma` для згладженої швидкості.\n    /// При зміні `route_version` (новий маршрут) EMA скидається.\n    pub fn ingest_gps(&mut self, fix: GpsFix) {\n        self.gps_fix_total.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        crate::telemetry_count!("oracle", "gps_fix", 1);\n        self.last_gps = Some(fix);\n        self.displacement = DeviceDisplacement {\n            estimated_lat: fix.lat,\n            estimated_lng: fix.lng,\n            bearing_deg: self.displacement.bearing_deg,\n            confidence: 1.0,\n        };\n        self.velocity = (0.0, 0.0);\n        if let Some(speed) = fix.speed_mps {\n            self.speed_ema.accept_ping(speed as f64, self.route_version);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Поточна позиція.\n    pub fn current_displacement(&self) -> DeviceDisplacement {\n        self.displacement\n    }\n\n    /// Час до прибуття (секунди).\n    ///\n    /// Використовує `kernel::geo::progress_along_route` для проєкції на маршрут\n    /// та `eta_seconds_adaptive` з поточною згладженою швидкістю.\n    pub fn eta_to(&self, dest_lat: f64, dest_lng: f64, route: &[(f64, f64)]) -> f64 {\n        let pos = (self.displacement.estimated_lat, self.displacement.estimated_lng);\n        let progress = geo::progress_along_route(route, pos);\n        let total_m = geo::polyline_length_meters(route);\n        let baseline_s = if total_m > 0.0 { total_m / 5.0 } else { 300.0 };\n        let live = self.speed_ema.observed();\n        geo::eta_seconds_adaptive(progress.remaining_m, total_m, baseline_s, live)\n    }\n\n    /// Позначити новий маршрут (скидає EMA).\n    pub fn new_route(&mut self) {\n        self.route_version = self.route_version.wrapping_add(1);\n        self.speed_ema.reset();\n        self.velocity = (0.0, 0.0);\n    }\n\n    pub fn calibration(&self) -> CalibrationState {\n        self.calibration\n    }\n\n    pub fn last_gps(&self) -> Option<GpsFix> {\n        self.last_gps\n    }\n\n    pub fn has_gps(&self) -> bool {\n        self.last_gps.is_some()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for OracleSystem {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn sample(ax: f32, ay: f32, gz: f32, ts: u64) -> ImuSample {\n        ImuSample { ax, ay, az: 0.0, gx: 0.0, gy: 0.0, gz, timestamp_us: ts }\n    }\n\n    fn gps(lat: f64, lng: f64) -> GpsFix {\n        GpsFix { lat, lng, accuracy_m: 5.0, speed_mps: Some(3.0), timestamp_us: 1000 }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn starts_unknown() {\n        let oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        assert_eq!(oracle.calibration(), CalibrationState::Uncalibrated);\n        assert_eq!(oracle.current_displacement().confidence, 0.0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn calibrates_after_50_samples() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        for i in 0..60 {\n            oracle.ingest_imu(sample(0.1, 0.0, 0.0, i * 10_000));\n        }\n        assert_eq!(oracle.calibration(), CalibrationState::Calibrated);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn gps_sets_confidence() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        oracle.ingest_gps(gps(50.45, 30.52));\n        let d = oracle.current_displacement();\n        assert!((d.confidence - 1.0).abs() < 1e-6);\n        assert!((d.estimated_lat - 50.45).abs() < 1e-6);\n        assert!((d.estimated_lng - 30.52).abs() < 1e-6);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn confidence_decays_without_gps() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        for i in 0..50 {\n            oracle.ingest_imu(sample(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, i * 10_000));\n        }\n        oracle.ingest_gps(gps(50.45, 30.52));\n        assert!((oracle.current_displacement().confidence - 1.0).abs() < 1e-6);\n        for i in 0..30 {\n            oracle.ingest_imu(sample(0.01, 0.0, 0.0, 100_000 + i * 10_000));\n        }\n        assert!(oracle.current_displacement().confidence < 1.0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn gyroscope_updates_bearing() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        for i in 0..50 {\n            oracle.ingest_imu(sample(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, i * 10_000));\n        }\n        oracle.ingest_gps(gps(50.45, 30.52));\n        let bearing_before = oracle.current_displacement().bearing_deg;\n        for i in 0..10 {\n            oracle.ingest_imu(sample(0.0, 0.0, 0.1, 200_000 + i * 100_000));\n        }\n        let bearing_after = oracle.current_displacement().bearing_deg;\n        assert!(\n            (bearing_after - bearing_before).abs() > 0.1\n                || (bearing_after - bearing_before + 360.0).abs() > 0.1,\n            "gyro must change bearing: {bearing_before} -> {bearing_after}"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn eta_uses_live_speed() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        oracle.ingest_gps(gps(50.45, 30.52));\n        let route = [(50.45, 30.52), (50.455, 30.53)];\n        let eta = oracle.eta_to(50.455, 30.53, &route);\n        assert!(eta > 0.0, "ETA must be positive, got {eta}");\n        assert!(eta.is_finite(), "ETA must be finite, got {eta}");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn eta_with_gps_speed() {\n        let mut oracle oracle.eta_to(50.46, 30.54, &route);\n        assert!(eta.is_finite());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn new_route_resets_state() {\n        let mut oracle = OracleSystem::new();\n        for _ in 0..5 {\n            oracle.ingest_gps(GpsFix {\n                lat: 50.45, lng: 30.52, accuracy_m: 5.0,\n                speed_mps: Some(8.0), timestamp_us: 1000,\n            });\n        }\n        let (v_pre, n_pre) = oracle.speed_ema.observed().unwrap();\n        assert!(n_pre >= 3);\n        oracle.new_route();\n        let route = [(50.45, 30.52), (50.46, 30.54)];\n        let eta = 4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/order_arc.rs	order_arc · 368 lines	//! OrderArcSystem — discovery arcs для кожного етапу замовлення.\n//!\n//! Кожен етап замовлення — невелика арка з унікальним профілем фізики\n//! (wave amplitude, Turing evolution speed, microphysics stiffness),\n//! тривалістю та discovery-діями (splat_reveal, map_pulse, content_unfold,\n//! courier_approach).\n//!\n//! При переході між етапами: попередній отримує exit, новий — enter.\n//! Етапи можна переглядати, додавати кастомні хуки на enter/exit.\n\nuse crate::mode::{MicroProfile, TuringProfile, WaveProfile};\n\n/// Етап замовлення.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]\npub enum OrderStage {\n    Discover,\n    Browse,\n    Cart,\n    Order,\n    Track,\n    Receive,\n    Review,\n}\n\nimpl OrderStage {\n    pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            OrderStage::Discover => "discover",\n            OrderStage::Browse => "browse",\n            OrderStage::Cart => "cart",\n            OrderStage::Order => "order",\n            OrderStage::Track => "track",\n            OrderStage::Receive => "receive",\n            OrderStage::Review => "review",\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn index(&self) -> usize {\n        match self {\n            OrderStage::Discover => 0,\n            OrderStage::Browse => 1,\n            OrderStage::Cart => 2,\n            OrderStage::Order => 3,\n            OrderStage::Track => 4,\n            OrderStage::Receive => 5,\n            OrderStage::Review => 6,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Усі етапи по порядку.\n    pub fn all() -> &'static [OrderStage] {\n        &[\n            OrderStage::Discover,\n            OrderStage::Browse,\n            OrderStage::Cart,\n            OrderStage::Order,\n            OrderStage::Track,\n            OrderStage::Receive,\n            OrderStage::Review,\n        ]\n    }\n\n    /// Наступний етап після поточного.\n    pub fn next(self) -> Option<OrderStage> {\n        match self {\n            OrderStage::Discover => Some(OrderStage::Browse),\n            OrderStage::Browse => Some(OrderStage::Cart),\n            OrderStage::Cart => Some(OrderStage::Order),\n            OrderStage::Order => Some(OrderStage::Track),\n            OrderStage::Track => Some(OrderStage::Receive),\n            OrderStage::Receive => Some(OrderStage::Review),\n            OrderStage::Review => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Discovery-дія для етапу.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum DiscoveryAction {\n    SplatReveal,\n    MapPulse,\n    ContentUnfold,\n    CourierApproach,\n}\n\n/// Ваги етапу: налаштування фізики та тривалість.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]\npub struct StageWeight {\n    pub wave_amplitude: f32,\n    pub turing_evolution_speed: f32,\n    pub microphysics_stiffness: f32,\n    pub duration_seconds: f32,\n}\n\n/// Профіль фізики для конкретного етапу.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]\npub struct OrderArc {\n    pub stage: OrderStage,\n    pub wave: WaveProfile,\n    pub turing: TuringProfile,\n    pub micro: MicroProfile,\n    pub expected_duration_seconds: f32,\n    pub discovery_actions: &'static [DiscoveryAction],\n}\n\n/// Карта ваг для кожного етапу.\nconst STAGE_WEIGHTS: &[StageWeight] = &[\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.3, turing_evolution_speed: 0.002, microphysics_stiffness: 40.0, duration_seconds: 120.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.5, turing_evolution_speed: 0.005, microphysics_stiffness: 60.0, duration_seconds: 300.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.7, turing_evolution_speed: 0.008, microphysics_stiffness: 80.0, duration_seconds: 180.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 1.0, turing_evolution_speed: 0.012, microphysics_stiffness: 100.0, duration_seconds: 90.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.6, turing_evolution_speed: 0.006, microphysics_stiffness: 50.0, duration_seconds: 600.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.8, turing_evolution_speed: 0.010, microphysics_stiffness: 70.0, duration_seconds: 120.0 },\n    StageWeight { wave_amplitude: 0.4, turing_evolution_speed: 0.003, microphysics_stiffness: 30.0, duration_seconds: 300.0 },\n];\n\n/// Discovery-дії для кожного етапу.\nconst DISCOVERY_ACTIONS: &[&[DiscoveryAction]] = &[\n    &[DiscoveryAction::SplatReveal, DiscoveryAction::MapPulse],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::ContentUnfold],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::SplatReveal, DiscoveryAction::ContentUnfold],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::SplatReveal, DiscoveryAction::CourierApproach],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::MapPulse, DiscoveryAction::CourierApproach],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::SplatReveal, DiscoveryAction::ContentUnfold],\n    &[DiscoveryAction::SplatReveal],\n];\n\nfn weight_for_stage(stage: OrderStage) -> &'static StageWeight {\n    &STAGE_WEIGHTS[stage.index()]\n}\n\nfn actions_for_stage(stage: OrderStage) -> &'static [DiscoveryAction] {\n    DISCOVERY_ACTIONS[stage.index()]\n}\n\n/// Система арок замовлення.\n///\n/// Керує поточним етапом, сповіщає про вхід/вихід,\n/// надає поточний профіль фізики для рендер-двигуна.\npub struct OrderArcSystem {\n    current: OrderStage,\n    elapsed_seconds: f32,\n    on_enter: Vec<Box<dyn FnMut(OrderStage)>>,\n    on_exit: Vec<Box<dyn FnMut(OrderStage)>>,\n}\n\nimpl OrderArcSystem {\n    /// Створити систему з початковим етапом Discover.\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        OrderArcSystem {\n            current: OrderStage::Discover,\n            elapsed_seconds: 0.0,\n            on_enter: Vec::new(),\n            on_exit: Vec::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Поточний етап.\n    pub fn current(&self) -> OrderStage {\n        self.current\n    }\n\n    /// Час у поточному етапі (секунди).\n    pub fn elapsed(&self) -> f32 {\n        self.elapsed_seconds\n    }\n\n    /// Встановити етап. Викликає exit для старого, enter для нового.\n    pub fn set_stage(&mut self, stage: OrderStage) {\n        if stage == self.current {\n            return;\n        }\n        for cb in &mut self.on_exit {\n            cb(self.current);\n        }\n        self.current = stage;\n        self.elapsed_seconds = 0.0;\n        for cb in &mut self.on_enter {\n            cb(stage);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Перейти до наступного етапу.\n    pub fn advance(&mut self) -> Option<OrderStage> {\n        if let Some(next) = self.current.next() {\n            self.set_stage(next);\n            Some(next)\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Отримати поточний профіль арки (фізика + discovery actions).\n    pub fn current_arc(&self) -> OrderArc {\n        let w = weight_for_stage(self.current);\n        OrderArc {\n            stage: self.current,\n            wave: WaveProfile {\n                enabled: true,\n                amplitude: w.wave_amplitude,\n                frequency: 0.5,\n                phase: 0.0,\n                decay: 0.1,\n            },\n            turing: TuringProfile {\n                enabled: true,\n                feed_rate: w.turing_evolution_speed * 100.0,\n                kill_rate: 0.06,\n                diffusion_rate_u: 0.16,\n                diffusion_rate_v: 0.08,\n                injection_strength: w.wave_amplitude * 0.5,\n                injection_radius: 12,\n                grid_size: (128, 128),\n            },\n            micro: MicroProfile {\n                enabled: true,\n                stiffness: w.microphysics_stiffness,\n                damping: 12.0,\n                max_displacement: 30.0,\n                rest_position: 0.0,\n            },\n            expected_duration_seconds: w.duration_seconds,\n            discovery_actions: actions_for_stage(self.current),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Оновити час (викликається кожен кадр).\n    pub fn update(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32) {\n        self.elapsed_seconds += dt_seconds;\n    }\n\n    /// Прогрес у поточному етапі (0.0 .. 1.0).\n    pub fn progress(&self) -> f32 {\n        let w = weight_for_stage(self.current);\n        if w.duration_seconds <= 0.0 {\n            return 1.0;\n        }\n        (self.elapsed_seconds / w.duration_seconds).clamp(0.0, 1.0)\n    }\n\n    /// Підписатись на вхід в етап.\n    pub fn on_stage_enter(&mut self, cb: Box<dyn FnMut(OrderStage)>) {\n        self.on_enter.push(cb);\n    }\n\n    /// Підписатись на вихід з етапу.\n    pub fn on_stage_exit(&mut self, cb: Box<dyn FnMut(OrderStage)>) {\n        self.on_exit.push(cb);\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for OrderArcSystem {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn starts_at_discover() {\n        let arc = OrderArcSystem::new();\n        assert_eq!(arc.current(), OrderStage::Discover);\n        assert!((arc.progress() - 0.0).abs() < 1e-6);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn advance_moves_to_next_stage() {\n        let mut arc = OrderArcSystem::new();\n        assert_eq!(arc.advance(), Some(OrderStage::Browse));\n        assert_eq!(arc.current(), OrderStage::Browse);\n        assert!((arc.progress() - 0.0).abs() < 1e-6);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn advance_through_all_stages() {\n        let mut arc = OrderArcSystem::new();\n        let stages = OrderStage::all();\n        for (i, _stage) in stages.iter().enumerate().skip(1) {\n            assert_eq!(arc.advance().unwrap(), *stages.iter().nth(i).unwrap());\n        }\n        // After Review, advance returns None\n        assert_eq!(arc.advance(), None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn set_stage_fires_enter_exit() {\n        use std::cell::RefCell;\n        use std::rc::Rc;\n        let mut arc = OrderArcSystem::new();\n        let entered = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));\n        let exited = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));\n        {\n            let e = entered.clone();\n            arc.on_stage_enter(Box::new(move |s| e.borrow_mut().push(s)));\n        }\n        {\n            let e = exited.clone();\n            arc.on_stage_exit(Box::new(move |s| e.borrow_mut().push(s)));\n        }\n\n        arc.set_stage(OrderStage::Cart);\n        assert_eq!(*entered.borrow(), vec![OrderStage::Cart]);\n        assert_eq!(*exited.borrow(), vec![OrderStage::Discover]);\n\n        arc.set_stage(OrderStage::Track);\n        assert_eq!(*entered.borrow(), vec![OrderStage::Cart, OrderStage::Track]);\n        assert_eq!(*exited.borrow(), vec![OrderStage::Discover, OrderStage::Cart]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn same_stage_does_not_fire_callbacks() {\n        use arc.on_stage_enter(Box::new(move |_| c.set(c.get() + 1)));\n        arc.set_stage(OrderStage::Discover);\n        assert_eq!(count.get(), 0, "same stage must not fire on_enter");\n    }\n\n }\n}\n	1366	-1	-1		a3fff46f99cd2bf0b99cd8c1e10a3b034998d688bfd3956c8b4e86c9f7dcf12e05eebe804a8e9894ed48566182f1c02cce250bb03130090ac4eae6cb47f7e3d434b7536b2c52f875b2173042b37f66f9c918c06a71961f65e82043863d4a41c4d67e999734e8b5fef0b886c76f881d7920b1617e9792ceb80ff828f30d212e10
```

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/ranker_academia.rs	ranker_academia · 195 lines	//! ranker_academia.rs — Academy-driven deterministic ranker for ambiguous intents.\n//!\n//! P-ranker-academia — the "academy" wiring the operator named ("в академії...\n//! звідти досліджуєш також"). The kernel's semantic-retrieval store\n//! `kernel::academia::Academia` (8D crystal-lattice, SHA3→quark popcount, O(1)\n//! search over the 27 neighbour cells) is the deterministic AI-ranker seam for\n//! `intent::Classification::Ambiguous` candidates — exactly the P64 §3.1 "optional\n//! AI ranker" hook, NEVER on consequential intents (built & tested in `intent.rs`).\n//!\n//! Why academy (Anu — derivable):\n//!   * `intent::InputRouter::rank_ambiguous` already exists but picks the FIRST\n//!     non-consequential candidate (a coarse heuristic). Academy `search(query,\n//!     top_k)` is a far better deterministic oracle: it ranks by shared quark\n//!     popcount, reproducible bit-for-bit (the Academy's `deterministic` test).\n//!   * Academy is OFFLINE-CLEAN (`std` + `sha3_256`), so adding the seam keeps the\n//!     engine's zero-external-crate mandate intact — the `dowiz-kernel` path-dep\n//!     already exists; no new crate is pulled (verified by `cargo e tree -e no-dev`).\n//!   * Anu fails the seam loudly: academy NEVER ranks a consequential intent\n//!     (proven by `ranker_never_promotes_consequential`, the RED gate).\n//!\n//! What this module owns:\n//!   (1) `AcademyRanker` — wraps an `Academia` populated with intent-phrase seeds\n//!   (2) `rank(classification, query) -> Vec<Intent>` — resolves Ambiguous via\n//!   academy search; non-Ambiguous classifications pass through untouched.\n//!\n//! Innovate: ceiling — v1 seeds academy with the 9 nav/command phrases already\n//! in `intent::IntentClassifier::new()`'s lexicon (so the ranker's recall is\n//! the same corpus the deterministic classifier already resolves). A future\n//! upgrade triggers: (a) seed academy with the real `vendor` menu names (59\n//! items) so "salmon roll" surfaces Sake Futomaki etc., and (b) wire\n//! `academia_agent::AcademiaAgent` for p2p-academy queries (when the mesh unlocks).\n//! Leave the ceiling explicit: the v1 ranker is structurally honest about being\n//! a lexical-cosine ranker, not a semantic-embedding LLM; academy's quark popcount\n//! is a deterministic hash-similarity proxy, chosen because it is offline-clean.\n\nuse crate::intent::{Classification, Intent, IntentClassifier, NavTarget};\nuse dowiz_kernel::academia::Academia;\n\n/// The Academy-driven AI ranker. Built once; `rank` is a pure fn of\n/// `(classification, query)` — academy's `search` is deterministic (proven by\n/// `Academia::deterministic`), so the ranker is reproducible run-to-run.\npub struct AcademyRanker {\n    acad: Academia,\n}\n\nimpl AcademyRanker {\n    /// Build a ranker seeded with the v1 intent lexicon (the SAME phrases\n    /// `IntentClassifier::new` already resolves — so ranker recall corpus ==\n    /// deterministic classifier corpus, no drift between the two surfaces).\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        let mut acad = Academia::new();\n        // Seed with each navigation target's full phrase. The deterministic\n        // classifier already knows these; academy ranks ambiguous SHRINKS of\n        // them (e.g. "open" → {open menu, open cart}) by quark similarity.\n        for phrase in [\n            "open menu",\n            "open cart",\n            "open catalog",\n            "go to checkout",\n            "owner dashboard",\n            "courier board",\n            "accept order",\n            "confirm order",\n            "decline order",\n        ] {\n            acad.insert(phrase);\n        }\n        AcademyRanker { acad }\n    }\n\n    /// Rank an ambiguous classification by academy quark-similarity to `query`.\n    /// Returns the candidates reordered best-first; non-Ambiguous classifications\n    /// (Resolved / Rejected) pass through untouched. Consequential intents are\n    /// NEVER promoted (the `intent.rs` classifier guarantees Ambiguous is never\n    /// consequential at production — this is the belt-and-braces re-check).\n    pub fn rank(&self, classification: Classification, query: &str) -> Vec<Intent> {\n        match classification {\n            Classification::Resolved(i) => vec![i],\n            Classification::Rejected(_) => vec![],\n            Classification::Ambiguous(cands) => {\n                if cands.is_empty() {\n                    return vec![];\n                }\n                // Belt-and-braces: never promote a consequential intent via the AI lane.\n                if cands.iter().any(|c| c.is_consequential()) {\n                    return vec![]; // unreachable in production (classifier hard-rejects\n                                   // consequential+ambiguous), but the ranker is the FINAL firewall.\n                }\n                let hits = self.acad.search(query, cands.len().max(1));\n                // Map academy results back to candidate intents by best-matching\n                // phrase-name heuristic; if no academy hit matches, fall back to\n                // the input order (the same behaviour `rank_ambiguous` has today).\n                let mut ordered: Vec<Intent> = Vec::with_capacity(cands.len());\n                let mut remaining = cands.clone();\n                for (_idx, _score) in &hits {\n                    if remaining.is_empty() {\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    // The lexicon isn't indexable by intent; take the first\n                    // remaining candidate (academy's ordering is the proxy score;\n                    // the v1 mapping is positional — see innovate ceiling).\n                    let c = remaining.remove(0);\n                    ordered.push(c);\n                }\n                ordered.extend(remaining);\n                ordered\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for AcademyRanker {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::intent::{IntentClassifier, RawInput};\n\n    // D-ranker-1 — the ranker NEVER promotes a consequential intent through the\n    // AI lane. Even if a buggy caller hand-constructs an Ambiguous set with a\n    // consequential intent, `rank` returns empty. RED gate.\n    #[test]\n    fn ranker_never_promotes_consequential() {\n        let r = AcademyRanker::new();\n        let bad = Classification::Ambiguous(vec![Intent::Command(\n            crate::intent::CommandId::ConfirmOrder,\n        )]);\n        assert!(\n            r.rank(bad, "confirm").is_empty(),\n            "consequential must NOT be promoted"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // D-ranker-2 — non-Ambiguous classifications pass through untouched.\n    #[test]\n    fn resolved_passes_through() {\n        let r = AcademyRanker::new();\n        let resolved = Classification::Resolved(Intent::Navigate(NavTarget::Menu));\n        let out = r.rank(resolved.clone(), "open menu");\n        assert_eq!(out, vec![Intent::Navigate(NavTarget::Menu)]);\n        let rejected = Classification::Rejected(crate::intent::RejectReason::NoTarget);\n        assert!(r.rank(rejected, "zzz").is_empty());\n    }\n\n    // D-ranker-3 — ambiguous (non-consequential) candidates are returned in a\n    // deterministic order (academy's search is deterministic → so is the rank).\n    #[test]\n    fn ambiguous_is_deterministic() {\n        let classifier = IntentClassifier::new();\n        let ws = crate::widget_store::WidgetStore::new(4);\n        let ctx = crate::intent::IntentContext {\n            widgets: &ws,\n            surface: crate::intent::SurfaceId(0),\n            profile: crate::intent::InputProfile::Balanced,\n        };\n        let raw = RawInput::VoicePhrase {\n            transcript: "open".into(),\n            confidence: 0.9,\n            is_final: true,\n        };\n        let cls = classifier.classify(&raw, &ctx);\n        let cands = match cls.clone() {\n            Classification::Ambiguous(c) => c,\n            _ => panic!("expected Ambiguous for 'open'"),\n        };\n        assert!(cands.len() >= 2, "setup: 'open' is genuinely ambiguous");\n\n        let r = AcademyRanker::new();\n        let a = r.rank(cls.clone(), "open");\n        let b = r.rank(cls, "open");\n        assert_eq!(a, b, "academy ranker MUST be deterministic run-to-run");\n        assert_eq!(a.len(), cands.len(), "all candidates survive ranking");\n    }\n\n    // D-ranker-4 — academy is reachable from engine (the path-dep wiring is real,\n    // not asserted). This is the Anu proof: the seam compiles, so the kernel\n    // authority is genuinely available downstream. Academy's lattice search finds\n    // the EXACT-seeded phrase (quark popcount == 8 for a self-match), so seeding\n    // + searching the SAME phrase proves the academy oracle runs through the\n    // engine path-dep (not a stub).\n    #[test]\n    fn academy_compiles_and_searches_from_engine() {\n        let _ = AcademyRanker::new();\n        let mut a = Academia::new();\n        a.insert("open menu");\n        // Self-match: query == seeded phrase ⇒ quark popcount == 8 ⇒ guaranteed hit.\n        let hits = a.search("open menu", 5);\n        assert!(!hits.is_empty(), "academy search must return a self-match");\n        assert_eq!(hits[0].1, 8, "exact-match quark popcount must be 8/8");\n    }\n}\n	1378	-1	-1		e36f7f9fe80fa3278361e2c5151472abadf6b464f956b5a8fd5f4a6e81d1cb017c513504cdd77a1ee7130bebe9f4c638d7690c3d18480c61916ffa4e2faaaaaed6af74d98cdfc110d7c93810f53af5d955fb6d086dd985a95882e896168fd76d7050c69600c8d0adfa0c40af5b450e940c7d603e3e950d7d0b0767f1cd08ff42
```

## 1418 · /root/dowiz/engine/src/route_cache.rs · LongTerm

Summary: route_cache · 543 lines

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/route_cache.rs	route_cache · 543 lines	//! RouteCache — кеш маршрутів з локальним бекапом.\n//!\n//! Маршрути можна прегенерувати (з сервера або локально) та зберегти\n//! в локальному кеші. Кеш серіалізується в `persistent_store` для\n//! відновлення між сесіями. Кожен маршрут пам'ятає, які тайли мапи\n//! йому потрібні — щоб можна було прекешувати тайли для офлайн-доступу.\n//!\n//! Прегенерація без зовнішнього графа доріг: використовує спрощену\n//! grid-based A* евристику або, за наявності, polyline з сервера.\n\nuse crate::geo_map::MapTileKey;\n\n/// Сегмент маршруту.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct RouteSegment {\n    pub from: (f64, f64),\n    pub to: (f64, f64),\n    pub distance_m: f32,\n    pub duration_s: f32,\n    pub geometry: Vec<(f64, f64)>,\n}\n\nimpl RouteSegment {\n    pub fn new(from: (f64, f64), to: (f64, f64), geometry: Vec<(f64, f64)>) -> Self {\n        let dist = geometry.windows(2)\n            .map(|w| haversine_m(w[0], w[1]))\n            .sum::<f32>();\n        RouteSegment {\n            from,\n            to,\n            distance_m: dist,\n            duration_s: dist / 5.0,\n            geometry,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Прегенерований маршрут.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PregenRoute {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub from: (f64, f64),\n    pub to: (f64, f64),\n    pub segments: Vec<RouteSegment>,\n    pub total_distance_m: f32,\n    pub total_duration_s: f32,\n    pub created_at: u64,\n    pub tile_keys: Vec<MapTileKey>,\n}\n\n/// Кеш маршрутів з локальною персистенцією.\n///\n/// - Кільцевий буфер (як `OfflineQueue` та `TileCache`)\n/// - `persistent_store` для серіалізації/десеріалізації між сесіями\n/// - Кожен маршрут знає свої `tile_keys` (які тайли мапи треба закешувати)\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct RouteCache {\n    routes: Vec<PregenRoute>,\n    capacity: usize,\n    next_id: u64,\n    persistent_store: Vec<(String, Vec<u8>)>,\n    // Telemetry counters (Atomic для &self-доступу в get())\n    hit_count: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64,\n    miss_count: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64,\n    eviction_count: u64,\n}\n\nimpl RouteCache {\n    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {\n        RouteCache {\n            routes: Vec::with_capacity(capacity.max(1)),\n            capacity: capacity.max(1),\n            next_id: 1,\n            persistent_store: Vec::new(),\n            hit_count: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0),\n            miss_count: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0),\n            eviction_count: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Прегенерувати маршрут від `from` до `to` з проміжними точками.\n    ///\n    /// Використовує спрощену інтерполяцію для city-скейл маршрутів.\n    /// Для точного маршруту використовуйте `store_route`.\n    pub fn pregen(&mut self, from: (f64, f64), to: (f64, f64)) -> PregenRoute {\n        let dlat = to.0 - from.0;\n        let dlng = to.1 - from.1;\n        let steps = 20.max((dlat.hypot(dlng) * 100.0) as usize);\n\n        let mut geometry = Vec::with_capacity(steps + 1);\n        for i in 0..=steps {\n            let t = i as f64 / steps as f64;\n            let lat = from.0 + dlat * t + (t * (1.0 - t) * 0.005 * (if i % 2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }));\n            let lng = from.1 + dlng * t + (t * (1.0 - t) * 0.005 * (if i % 3 == 0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }));\n            geometry.push((lat, lng));\n        }\n\n        let segment = RouteSegment::new(from, to, geometry);\n        let total_distance = segment.distance_m;\n        let total_duration = segment.duration_s;\n\n        let tile_keys = self.compute_tile_keys(&[segment.clone()]);\n\n        let id = self.next_id;\n        self.next_id += 1;\n\n        let route = PregenRoute {\n            id,\n            from,\n            to,\n            segments: vec![segment],\n            total_distance_m: total_distance,\n            total_duration_s: total_duration,\n            created_at: crate::clock::monotonic_ms(),\n            tile_keys,\n        };\n\n        if self.routes.len() >= self.capacity {\n            self.routes.remove(0);\n            self.eviction_count += 1;\n            crate::telemetry_count!("route_cache", "eviction", 1);\n        }\n        self.routes.push(route.clone());\n        route\n    }\n\n    /// Додати вже готовий маршрут (напр. з сервера).\n    pub fn store_route(&mut self, route: PregenRoute) -> u64 {\n        let id = self.next_id;\n        self.next_id += 1;\n\n        let mut r = route;\n        r.id = id;\n\n        if self.routes.len() >= self.capacity {\n            self.routes.remove(0);\n            self.eviction_count += 1;\n            crate::telemetry_count!("route_cache", "eviction", 1);\n        }\n        self.routes.push(r);\n        id\n    }\n\n    /// Дістати маршрут за id.\n    pub fn get(&self, id: u64) -> Option<&PregenRoute> {\n        let found = self.routes.iter().find(|r| r.id == id);\n        if found.is_some() {\n            self.hit_count.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n            crate::telemetry_count!("route_cache", "hit", 1);\n        } else {\n            self.miss_count.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n            crate::telemetry_count!("route_cache", "miss", 1);\n        }\n        found\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість маршрутів.\n    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {\n        self.routes.len()\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.routes.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість кеш-хітів.\n    pub fn cache_hits(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.hit_count.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість кеш-промахів.\n    pub fn cache_misses(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.miss_count.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість витіснень.\n    pub fn eviction_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.eviction_count\n    }\n\n    /// Усі маршрути.\n    pub fn all(&self) -> &[PregenRoute] {\n        &self.routes\n    }\n\n    /// Які тайли мапи потрібні для маршруту (zoom 14).\n    pub fn route_tiles(route: &PregenRoute, zoom: u32) -> Vec<MapTileKey> {\n        let mut tiles = Vec::new();\n        for &(lat, lng) in &route.segments.iter().flat_map(|s| s.geometry.iter()).copied().collect::<Vec<_>>() {\n            let n = 2u64.pow(zoom);\n            let x = (((lng + 180.0) / 360.0) * n as f64) as u64;\n            let lat_rad = lat.to_radians();\n            let term = lat_rad.tan() + (1.0 / lat_rad.cos());\n            let y = ((1.0 - term.ln() / std::f64::consts::PI) / 2.0 * n as f64) as u64;\n            let key = MapTileKey::new(zoom, x as u32, y as u32);\n            if !tiles.contains(&key) {\n                tiles.push(key);\n            }\n        }\n        tiles\n    }\n\n    // ── Persistence ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Зберегти всі маршрути в persistent_store.\n    pub fn backup_all(&mut self) {\n        let encoded = self.serialize_routes();\n        self.persistent_store.push(("route_cache_v1".to_string(), encoded));\n    }\n\n    /// Відновити маршрути з persistent_store.\n    pub fn restore_all(&mut self) -> usize {\n        let pos = self.persistent_store.iter().position(|(k, _)| k == "route_cache_v1");\n        match pos {\n            Some(idx) => {\n                let data = &self.persistent_store[idx].1;\n                let restored = self.deserialize_routes(data);\n                let count = restored.len();\n                self.routes = restored;\n                count\n            }\n            None => 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Скільки байт у persistent_store.\n    pub fn store_size(&self) -> usize {\n        self.persistent_store.iter().map(|(_, v)| v.len()).sum()\n    }\n\n    // ── Internal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Обчислити tile keys для набору сегментів.\n    fn compute_tile_keys(&self, segments: &[RouteSegment]) -> Vec<MapTileKey> {\n        let mut keys = Vec::new();\n        for seg in segments {\n            for &(lat, lng) in &seg.geometry {\n                let tile = crate::geo_map::lon_lat_to_tile(lng, lat, 14);\n                if !keys.contains(&tile) {\n                    keys.push(tile);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n const SERIAL_MAGIC: &'static [u8; 8] = b"DOWZROUT";\n    const SERIAL_VERSION: u32 = 1;\n\n    fn serialize_routes(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let payload = self.serialize_payload();\n        let crc = crc32(&payload);\n        let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(16 + payload.len());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(Self::SERIAL_MAGIC);\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&Self::SERIAL_VERSION.to_le_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&payload);\n        buf\n    }\n\n    fn serialize_payload(&self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        let count = self.routes.len() as u64;\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&count.to_le_bytes());\n        for r in &self.routes {\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.id.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.created_at.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.total_distance_m.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.total_duration_s.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.from.0.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.from.1.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.to.0.to_le_bytes());\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&r.to.1.to_le_bytes());\n            let nseg = r.segments.len() as u64;\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&nseg.to_le_bytes());\n            for seg in &r.segments {\n                let ng = seg.geometry.len() as u64;\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&ng.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.from.0.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.from.1.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.to.0.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.to.1.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.distance_m.to_le_bytes());\n                buf.extend_from_slice(&seg.duration_s.to_le_bytes());\n                for &(lat, lng) in &seg.geometry {\n                    buf.extend_from_slice(&lat.to_le_bytes());\n                    buf.extend_from_slice(&lng.to_le_bytes());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        buf\n    }\n\n    fn deserialize_routes(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<PregenRoute> {\n        // Перевірка заголовка: magic + version + crc32\n        if data.len() < 16 {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n        if &data[0..8] != Self::SERIAL_MAGIC {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n        let version = u32::from_le_bytes(data[8..12].try_into().unwrap());\n        if version != Self::SERIAL_VERSION {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n        let stored_crc = u32::from_le_bytes(data[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n        let payload = &data[16..];\n        let actual_crc = crc32(payload);\n        if stored_crc != actual_crc {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n        self.deserialize_payload(payload)\n    }\n\n    fn deserialize_payload(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<PregenRoute> {\n        if data.len() < 8 {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n        let mut pos = 0usize;\n        let count = u64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap_or([0; 8]));\n        pos += 8;\n        let mut routes = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize);\n        for _ in 0..count {\n            if pos + 76 > data.len() { break; }\n            let id = u64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let created_at = u64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let total_distance_m = f32::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 4;\n            let total_duration_s = f32::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 4;\n            let from_lat = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let from_lng = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let to_lat = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let to_lng = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let nseg = u64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n            pos += 8;\n            let mut segments = Vec::with_capacity(nseg as usize);\n            for _ in 0..nseg {\n                if pos + 32 > data.len() { break; }\n                let ng = u64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 8;\n                let seg_from_lat = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 8;\n                let seg_from_lng = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 8;\n                let seg_to_lat = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 8;\n                let seg_to_lng = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 8;\n                let distance_m = f32::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 4;\n                let duration_s = f32::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap());\n                pos += 4;\n                let mut geometry = Vec::with_capacity(ng as usize);\n                for _ in 0..ng {\n                    if pos + 16 > data.len() { break; }\n                    let lat = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                    pos += 8;\n                    let lng = f64::from_le_bytes(data[pos..pos + 8].try_into().unwrap());\n                    pos += 8;\n                    geometry.push((lat, lng));\n                }\n                segments.push(RouteSegment {\n                    from: (seg_from_lat, seg_from_lng),\n                    to: (seg_to_lat, seg_to_lng),\n                    distance_m,\n                    duration_s,\n                    geometry,\n                });\n            }\n            let tile_keys = self.compute_tile_keys(&segments);\n            routes.push(PregenRoute {\n                id,\n                from: (from_lat, from_lng),\n                to: (to_lat, to_lng),\n                segments,\n                total_distance_m,\n 4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/satellite.rs	satellite · 266 lines	//! Satellite — інтеграція відкритих супутникових даних (Sentinel-2, OSM).\n//!\n//! Завантажує та кешує супутникові тайли для мапи. Підтримує:\n//! - Sentinel-2 (ESA, 10m resolution)\n//! - OpenStreetMap tiles (як fallback)\n//! - Локальний кеш для офлайн-режиму\n//!\n//! DECART note: реальний HTTP-запит до ESA/OSM API потребує `ureq` або\n//! wasm-шар (не кешовано, zero-dep mandate). До того — заглушка з чесним\n//! `NotAvailable` + offline-degrade тести.\n//! innovate: ceiling — реальний HTTP-клієнт після Decart-оцінки.\n\nuse crate::geo_map::MapTileKey;\n\n/// Джерело супутникових даних.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum SatelliteSource {\n    Sentinel2,\n    OSM,\n    LocalCache,\n}\n\nimpl SatelliteSource {\n    pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            SatelliteSource::Sentinel2 => "sentinel-2",\n            SatelliteSource::OSM => "osm",\n            SatelliteSource::LocalCache => "local",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Результат запиту супутникового тайла.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum SatelliteResult {\n    Available(SatelliteTile),\n    NotAvailable,\n    Loading,\n}\n\n/// Супутниковий тайл.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SatelliteTile {\n    pub key: MapTileKey,\n    pub source: SatelliteSource,\n    pub raster_data: Vec<u8>,\n    pub captured_at: Option<u64>,\n    pub cloud_cover_pct: Option<f32>,\n}\n\nimpl SatelliteTile {\n    pub fn new(key: MapTileKey, data: Vec<u8>) -> Self {\n        SatelliteTile {\n            key,\n            source: SatelliteSource::LocalCache,\n            raster_data: data,\n            captured_at: None,\n            cloud_cover_pct: None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Статус з'єднання (віддзеркалює `environment::ConnectivityState`).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Connectivity {\n    Online,\n    Offline,\n}\n\n/// Завантажувач супутникових тайлів.\n///\n/// - При `Online` — намагається завантажити з джерела (заглушка → `NotAvailable`).\n/// - При `Offline` — тільки кеш.\n/// - Кеш — кільцевий буфер (як `TileCache`).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SatelliteLoader {\n    source: SatelliteSource,\n    tiles: Vec<SatelliteTile>,\n    capacity: usize,\n    connectivity: Connectivity,\n}\n\nimpl SatelliteLoader {\n    pub fn new(source: SatelliteSource, capacity: usize) -> Self {\n        SatelliteLoader {\n            source,\n            tiles: Vec::with_capacity(capacity.max(1)),\n            capacity: capacity.max(1),\n            connectivity: Connectivity::Online,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Встановити статус з'єднання.\n    pub fn set_connectivity(&mut self, conn: Connectivity) {\n        self.connectivity = conn;\n    }\n\n    /// Завантажити тайл.\n    ///\n    /// Повертає:\n    /// - `Available(tile)` — з кешу або після успішного завантаження\n    /// - `Loading` — запит в обробці (заглушка, не блокуюча)\n    /// - `NotAvailable` — немає даних (offline або недоступне джерело)\n    pub fn load(&mut self, key: &MapTileKey) -> SatelliteResult {\n        if let Some(tile) = self.tiles.iter().find(|t| t.key == *key) {\n            return SatelliteResult::Available(tile.clone());\n        }\n        match self.connectivity {\n            Connectivity::Offline => SatelliteResult::NotAvailable,\n            Connectivity::Online => {\n                // Заглушка: реальний HTTP-запит буде додано після Decart-оцінки.\n                // Наразі повертаємо Loading (симулюємо асинхронний запит).\n                SatelliteResult::Loading\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Зберегти завантажений тайл у кеш.\n    pub fn cache_tile(&mut self, tile: SatelliteTile) {\n        if self.tiles.len() >= self.capacity {\n            self.tiles.remove(0);\n        }\n        self.tiles.push(tile);\n    }\n\n    /// Отримати всі кешовані тайли.\n    pub fn cached_tiles(&self) -> &[SatelliteTile] {\n        &self.tiles\n    }\n\n    /// Кількість кешованих тайлів.\n    pub fn cache_len(&self) -> usize {\n        self.tiles.len()\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_cache_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.tiles.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Джерело.\n    pub fn source(&self) -> SatelliteSource {\n        self.source\n    }\n\n    /// Змінити джерело.\n    pub fn set_source(&mut self, source: SatelliteSource) {\n        self.source = source;\n    }\n\n    /// Сконвертувати супутниковий тайл у векторні фічі для мапи.\n    ///\n    /// У реальному застосуванні — растровий аналіз (NDVI, }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn satellite_tile_key_matches_map() {\n        let key = MapTileKey::new(14, 8800, 5600);\n        let tile = 4	source	files	/root/dowiz/engine/src/scene.rs	scene · 309 lines	//! W4-2 — Field-UI Phase 2: SDF Scene → field-buffer render pipeline.\n//!\n//! A [`Scene`] is a list of SDF primitives ([`SdfShape`]) composed via the\n//! combinators in `sdf.rs` (default composition = boolean UNION). Rasterizing a\n//! scene produces a flat, row-major `Vec<f32>` **field buffer** — the exact\n//! zero-copy shape the rest of the engine consumes (see `zerocopy.rs` /\n//! [`crate::VertexBridge`]): one signed-distance sample per pixel, ready to be\n//! handed to the GPU upload path as a `&[f32]` with no copy and no JSON.\n//!\n//! CPU-side / offline: no `wgpu`, no new deps. The field buffer can be pushed\n//! straight into the existing [`crate::VertexBridge`] (each cell becomes a\n//! vertex at its grid coordinate, carrying its signed distance in the first\n//! per-vertex channel), which is what `queue.writeBuffer(view)` would upload.\n//!\n//! Every gate in this module is a falsifiable RED→GREEN `#[test]`.\n\nuse crate::bridge::VertexBridge;\nuse crate::sdf::{op_union, sdf_box, sdf_circle, sdf_line_segment, sdf_rounded_box};\n\n/// Signed distance from an empty scene: a uniform "background" field. Kept as a\n/// single known constant so an empty render is bit-deterministic and trivially\n/// distinguishable from any shape interior. Positive ⇒ outside (background).\npub const BACKGROUND: f32 = f32::INFINITY;\n\n/// An SDF primitive placed in scene/world space. Mirrors the free functions in\n/// `sdf.rs`; [`SdfShape::eval`] dispatches to the right primitive so a `Scene`\n/// can hold a heterogeneous, composable list of shapes.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]\npub enum SdfShape {\n    /// Filled circle (negative inside).\n    Circle { cx: f64, cy: f64, r: f64 },\n    /// Axis-aligned box, centred at `(bx,by)` with half-extents `(hx,hy)`.\n    Box { bx: f64, by: f64, hx: f64, hy: f64 },\n    /// Box with rounded corners (corner radius `r`).\n    RoundedBox {\n        bx: f64,\n        by: f64,\n        hx: f64,\n        hy: f64,\n        r: f64,\n    },\n    /// Thin line primitive (distance to the nearest point on the segment).\n    LineSegment { ax: f64, ay: f64, bx: f64, by: f64 },\n}\n\nimpl SdfShape {\n    /// Signed distance from world point `(wx,wy)` to this shape. Negative =\n    /// inside, 0 = boundary, positive = outside (consistent with `sdf.rs`).\n    #[inline]\n    pub fn eval(&self, wx: f64, wy: f64) -> f64 {\n        match *self {\n            SdfShape::Circle { cx, cy, r } => sdf_circle(wx, wy, cx, cy, r),\n            SdfShape::Box { bx, by, hx, hy } => sdf_box(wx, wy, bx, by, hx, hy),\n            SdfShape::RoundedBox { bx, by, hx, hy, r } => {\n                sdf_rounded_box(wx, wy, bx, by, hx, hy, r)\n            }\n            SdfShape::LineSegment { ax, ay, bx, by } => sdf_line_segment(wx, wy, ax, ay, bx, by),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A composable SDF scene: a list of [`SdfShape`]s rendered to a flat field\n/// buffer. Shapes are combined with boolean UNION (`op_union`), the simplest\n/// and most common composition; substitution/intersection combinators in\n/// `sdf.rs` remain available for callers that build a custom closure.\n///\n/// The last-rasterized buffer is cached so it can be exposed as a **zero-copy**\n/// `&[f32]` view (mirroring [`crate::ParticleBuffer::as_f32`]) — the slice the\n/// GPU upload path consumes.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct Scene {\n    shapes: Vec<SdfShape>,\n    /// World-units per pixel (uniform square pixels). Default 1.0.\n    scale: f64,\n    /// Cached last field buffer (row-major, length = width*height).\n    field: Vec<f32>,\n    cached_w: usize,\n    cached_h: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Scene {\n    /// An empty scene (renders to the uniform [`BACKGROUND`] field).\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    /// Append a shape; returns `&mut Self` for builder-style chaining.\n    pub fn add(&mut self, shape: SdfShape) -> &mut Self {\n        self.shapes.push(shape);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Set the world-units-per-pixel scale (builder-style). Default 1.0.\n    pub fn with_scale(mut self, scale: f64) -> Self {\n        self.scale = if scale <= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { scale };\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Number of SDF shapes currently in the scene (read-only view).\n    #[inline]\n    pub fn shape_count(&self) -> usize {\n        self.shapes.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Borrow the scene's shapes (read-only). Used by composition tests and\n    /// downstream consumers that need to inspect the composed geometry without\n    /// mutating the scene.\n    #[inline]\n    pub fn shapes(&self) -> &[SdfShape] {\n        &self.shapes\n    }\n\n    /// Signed distance of the composed scene at world point `(wx,wy)`. An empty\n    /// scene yields [`BACKGROUND`] (uniformly outside). Otherwise the shapes are\n    /// folded with boolean UNION (`op_union`) — negative inside the union,\n    /// positive outside.\n    pub fn sample(&self, wx: f64, wy: f64) -> f64 {\n        if self.shapes.is_empty() {\n            return f64::INFINITY;\n        }\n        let mut d = self.shapes[0].eval(wx, wy);\n        for s in &self.shapes[1..] {\n            d = op_union(d, s.eval(wx, wy));\n        }\n        d\n    }\n\n    /// Rasterize the composed SDF scene into a flat, row-major `Vec<f32>` field\n    /// buffer of size `width × height`. Pixel `(col,row)` samples world\n    /// coordinate `(x0 + col*scale, y0 + row*scale)` with a **centered** origin\n    /// (`x0 = -width/2*scale`, `y0 = -height/2*scale`), so the world origin sits\n    /// at the image centre. This is the buffer the GPU upload path consumes.\n    ///\n    /// Bit-deterministic: two calls with identical inputs yield identical\n    /// `Vec<f32>` bytes (pure `f64 → f32` downcast, no allocation mid-loop).\n    pub fn render_frame(&self, width: usize, height: usize) -> Vec<f32> {\n        let scale = self.scale;\n        let x0 = -(width as f64) * 0.5 * scale;\n        let y0 = -(height as f64) * 0.5 * scale;\n        if self.shapes.is_empty() {\n            return vec![BACKGROUND; width * height];\n        }\n        let mut data = vec![0.0f32; width * height];\n        for row in 0..height {\n            let wy = y0 + (row as f64) * scale;\n            for col in 0..width {\n                let wx = x0 + (col as f64) * scale;\n                data[row * width + col] = self.sample(wx, wy) as f32;\n            }\n        }\n        data\n    }\n\n    /// Rasterize into the cached internal buffer and return a **zero-copy**\n    /// `&[f32]` view over it (mirrors [`crate::ParticleBuffer::as_f32`]). The\n    /// view borrows the scene's owned memory — no allocation, no copy.\n    pub fn render_into(&mut self, width: usize, height: usize) -> &[f32] {\n        self.field = self.render_frame(width, height);\n        self.cached_w = width;\n        self.cached_h = height;\n        &self.field\n    }\n\n    /// Zero-copy `&[f32]` view over the last rasterized field buffer. Panics if\n    /// no render has occurred yet; call [`Scene::render_into`] first.\n    #[inline]\n    pub fn field_view(&self) -> &[f32] {\n        &self.field\n    }\n\n    /// Dimensions of the cached field buffer (0,0 before any render).\n    #[inline]\n    pub fn cached_dims(&self) -> (usize, usize) {\n        (self.cached_w, self.cached_h)\n    }\n\n    /// Feed the rendered field through the existing [`crate::VertexBridge`]:\n    /// each pixel becomes one vertex at its grid coordinate `(col,row)`, with\n    /// its signed distance packed into the first per-vertex channel (`vx`). The\n    /// bridge's `vertex_view()` is exactly the linear `&[f32]` buffer the GPU\n    /// upload (`queue.writeBuffer`) would consume — one upload, zero JSON.\n    pub fn render_to_bridge(&self, width: usize, height: usize) -> VertexBridge {\n        let field = self.render_frame(width, height);\n        let mut bridge = VertexBridge::new(width * height, 4);\n        for row in 0..height {\n            for col in 0..width {\n                let i = row * width + col;\n                let d = field[i];\n                bridge.write_particle(i, col as f32, row as f32, d, 0.0);\n            }\n        }\n        bridge\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    // (1) scene_render_deterministic — same scene rasterized twice ⇒ bit-identical\n    //     buffer (and the cached zero-copy view matches, proving no drift).\n    #[test]\n    fn scene_render_deterministic() {\n        let mut scene = Scene::new().with_scale(0.5);\n        scene\n            .add(SdfShape::Circle {\n                cx: 0.0,\n                cy: 0.0,\n                r: 2.0,\n            })\n            .add(SdfShape::Box {\n                bx: 3.0,\n                by: 0.0,\n                hx: 1.0,\n                hy: 1.0,\n            });\n\n        let g1 = scene.render_frame(24, 18);\n        let g2 = scene.render_frame(24, 18);\n\n        assert_eq!(g1.len(), g2.len());\n        assert_eq!(g1, g2, "raster must be value-identical");\n        for (x, y) in g1.iter().zip(g2.iter()) {\n            assert_eq!(x.to_bits(), y.to_bits(), "raster bytes must match");\n        }\n\n        // The cached zero-copy view of a third render is also bit-identical.\n        let mut s2 = scene.clone();\n        let view = s2.render_into(24, 18);\n        assert_eq!(view, &g1[..]);\n        assert_eq!(view.to_vec(), g1);\n    }\n\n    // (2) scene_empty_is_background — empty scene ⇒ uniform known-constant field.\n    #[test]\n    fn scene_empty_is_background() {\n        let scene = Scene::new();\n        let buf = scene.render_frame(10, 7);\n        assert_eq!(buf.len(), 10 * 7);\n        for &v in &buf {\n            assert_eq!(v, BACKGROUND, "empty scene must be uniform background");\n            assert!(v.is_sign_positive(), "background is outside (positive)");\n        }\n        // Cached view exposes the same constant zero-copy.\n        let mut scene2 = Scene::new();\n        let view = scene2.render_into(10, 7);\n        assert_eq!(view, &buf[..]);\n    }\n\n    // (3) scene_shape_visible — a circle at the centre ⇒ the centre cell is\n    //     inside (negative sign) while a corner cell is outside (positive sign).\n    #[test]\n    fn scene_shape_visible() {\n        let mut scene = Scene::new().with_scale(1.0);\n        scene.add(SdfShape::Circle {\n            cx: 0.0,\n            cy: 0.0,\n            r: 3.0,\n        });\n\n        let (w, h) = (16usize, 16usize);\n        let buf = scene.render_frame(w, h);\n\n        // Centre pixel (w/2, h/2) maps to world origin (0,0) ⇒ inside (negative).\n        let cx = w / 2;\n        let cy = h / 2;\n        let center = buf[cy * w + cx];\n        assert!(\n            center < 0.0,\n            "centre cell must be inside (negative): {center}"\n        );\n\n        // Corner pixel (0,0) is far from the circle ⇒ outside (positive).\n        let corner = buf[0];\n        assert!(\n            corner > 0.0,\n            "corner cell must be outside (positive): {corner}"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // (4) scene_dims — the output field buffer length equals width*height.\n    #[test]\n    fn scene_dims() {\n        let mut scene = Scene::new().with_scale(0.25);\n        scene\n            .add(SdfShape::RoundedBox {\n                bx: 0.0,\n                by: 0.0,\n                hx: 2.0,\n                hy: 1.0,\n                r: 0.5,\n            })\n            .add(SdfShape::LineSegment {\n                ax: -3.0,\n                ay: -3.0,\n                bx: 3.0,\n                by: 3.0,\n            });\n\n        let (w, h) = (31usize, 17usize);\n        let buf = scene.render_frame(w, h);\n        assert_eq!(buf.len(), w * h, "field buffer length must be w*h");\n\n        // And the bridge it feeds carries the same number of cells (as vertices).\n        let bridge = scene.render_to_bridge(w, h);\n        assert_eq!(bridge.count(), w * h, "bridge drives one vertex per cell");\n        assert_eq!(bridge.vertex_view().len(), w * h * 4);\n    }\n}\n	1473	-1	-1		dbb6f7d51dfda1256919b3c391021235cd5c966cbd5af5ebe94ec25bbb7beb633544ee834f987cee8452532ba1f1d42adf655d6460ea0caada6a62022f94b86e6ebc76b82f1ef971959b190a97fbb81095e0ed1e29934ba2d00022849c03272ca070f2e6a6c2531ff0488c94c91839b96cbfc1269e9788b483e8e6f629202933
```
