## 14074 · /root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/wallet/draft.rs · LongTerm

Summary: draft · 491 lines

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/wallet/draft.rs	draft · 491 lines	//! M3 — the `Draft`→`PaymentInflight` state machine + idempotency key minting (X6).\n//!\n//! The idempotency key is **P60's** — re-exported, never redefined. It is minted EXACTLY\n//! ONCE, at draft creation, using P60's derivation verbatim, and stored IN the draft — never\n//! regenerated (R4 §3.3). Regeneration is the double-charge bug; this module refuses it.\n//!\n//! The machine has exactly two states (`DraftState`), modeled as an event-sourced saga\n//! (`DraftEvent`), mirroring the kernel `decide`/`fold` shape. Tests assert on the EVENT\n//! SEQUENCE (item 3), not just end-state. NO CRDT (R4 §3.1).\n\nuse alloc::string::{String, ToString};\nuse alloc::vec::Vec;\nuse crate::event_log::sha3_256;\nuse crate::money::{Currency, Money};\nuse crate::ports::payment_provider::{IdempotencyKey, PaymentStatus};\n\nuse crate::wallet::outbox::reconnect_draft;\nuse crate::wallet::record::{Address, Contact, PaymentMethodRef, WalletRecord};\n/// Content id of the draft at creation (the draft's stable key).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub struct DraftId(pub [u8; 32]);\n\n/// The offline checkout draft. Held locally; restored on reconnect (§16.52).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct CheckoutDraft {\n    pub draft_id: DraftId,\n    pub order_id: String,\n    pub cart: CartSnapshot,\n    pub wallet_fill: WalletFill,\n    /// Minted ONCE at creation, NEVER regenerated (R4 §3.3).\n    pub idem_key: IdempotencyKey,\n    pub state: DraftState,\n}\n\n/// A point-in-time cart snapshot: integer Money lines (kernel `Money`), no f64.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct CartSnapshot {\n    pub currency: Currency,\n    pub lines: Vec<CartLine>,\n}\n\n/// One cart line: leaf id + qty + unit price (Money, i64 minor units).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct CartLine {\n    pub leaf_id: String,\n    pub qty: u32,\n    pub unit: Money,\n}\n\n/// The autofilled name/address/contact/method_ref pulled from the wallet.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]\npub struct WalletFill {\n    pub name: Option<String>,\n    pub address: Option<Address>,\n    pub contact: Option<Contact>,\n    pub method_ref: Option<PaymentMethodRef>,\n}\n\nimpl WalletFill {\n    /// Snapshot the autofill-relevant slots from a [`WalletRecord`].\n    pub fn from_wallet(rec: &WalletRecord) -> Self {\n        WalletFill {\n            name: rec.name.clone(),\n            address: rec.addresses.first().cloned(),\n            contact: rec.contact.clone(),\n            method_ref: rec.method_ref.clone(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The exact two-state machine R4 §3.3 prescribes. A third state is unrepresentable.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum DraftState {\n    /// Editing locally; nothing submitted. Reconnect ⇒ resume locally.\n    Draft,\n    /// Payment request WAS sent (set optimistically the instant of send, before any ack).\n    /// Reconnect ⇒ query_status_by_key FIRST, never blind replay (§4.4).\n    PaymentInflight,\n}\n\n/// Event-sourced saga (item 3 — tests assert on the sequence, not just end-state).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum DraftEvent {\n    DraftCreated {\n        draft_id: DraftId,\n        order_id: String,\n    },\n    /// Exactly once, at creation.\n    IdemKeyMinted {\n        key: IdempotencyKey,\n    },\n    FieldFilled {\n        field: FilledField,\n    },\n    /// Draft -> PaymentInflight (optimistic).\n    PaymentSubmitted,\n    /// From query_status_by_key.\n    StatusResolved {\n        status: PaymentStatus,\n    },\n    /// Terminal: committed or user-abandoned.\n    DraftCleared {\n        draft_id: DraftId,\n    },\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FilledField {\n    Name,\n    Address,\n    Contact,\n    Method,\n}\n\n/// Client-side UX guard (NOT the security boundary — that is P60 M7, server-side).\npub const MAX_OPEN_INFLIGHT_DRAFTS: usize = 1;\n\n/// Mint an idempotency key with P60's derivation, VERBATIM (X6, §4.2):\n/// `IdempotencyKey(event_log::sha3_256(b"dowiz.pay.idem\\0" ‖ order_id ‖ wallet_id ‖ nonce))`.\npub fn mint_idem_key(order_id: &str, wallet_id: &[u8; 32], nonce: &[u8; 12]) -> IdempotencyKey {\n    IdempotencyKey(sha3_256(\n        &[\n            b"dowiz.pay.idem\\0".as_slice(),\n            order_id.as_bytes(),\n            wallet_id.as_slice(),\n            nonce.as_slice(),\n        ]\n        .concat(),\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Create a fresh draft. Mints the idem key ONCE and returns the initial event log.\npub fn create_draft(\n    draft_id: DraftId,\n    order_id: String,\n    cart: CartSnapshot,\n    wallet_fill: WalletFill,\n    wallet_id: &[u8; 32],\n    nonce: &[u8; 12],\n) -> (CheckoutDraft, Vec<DraftEvent>) {\n    let key = mint_idem_key(&order_id, wallet_id, nonce);\n    let draft = CheckoutDraft {\n        draft_id,\n        order_id: order_id.clone(),\n        cart,\n        wallet_fill,\n        idem_key: key,\n        state: DraftState::Draft,\n    };\n    let events = vec![\n        DraftEvent::DraftCreated { draft_id, order_id },\n        DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted { key },\n    ];\n    (draft, events)\n}\n\n/// The pure `decide` for the draft saga: fold the event log into the draft's observable state.\n/// Returns (state, minted_key, last_resolved_status). Fail-closed on a duplicate key mint.\npub fn fold(\n    events: &[DraftEvent],\n) -> Result<(DraftState, Option<IdempotencyKey>, Option<PaymentStatus>), DraftFoldError> {\n    let mut state = DraftState::Draft;\n    let mut key: Option<IdempotencyKey> = None;\n    let mut status: Option<PaymentStatus> = None;\n    for e in events {\n        match e {\n            DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted { key: k } => {\n                // The key MUST be minted exactly once (anti-regeneration teeth, §4.3).\n                if key.is_some() {\n                    return Err(DraftFoldError::KeyRegenerated);\n                }\n                key = Some(*k);\n            }\n            DraftEvent::PaymentSubmitted => state = DraftState::PaymentInflight,\n            DraftEvent::StatusResolved { status: s } => status = Some(s.clone()),\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((state, key, status))\n}\n\n/// A draft cannot be in two `PaymentInflight` states; the only structural error is a\n/// regenerated key (which would be the double-charge bug — refused at the fold).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum DraftFoldError {\n    KeyRegenerated,\n}\n\n/// The kernel-local checkout caller for P66 (BLUEPRINT-P66-data-wallet-offline-drafts.md).\n///\n/// `create_draft` / `fold` had ZERO production callers. This is the real wiring:\n/// given a [`Cart`] snapshot and the autofilled wallet fields, build the\n/// single-writer LWW [`CheckoutDraft`] + its initial event log. The idempotency\n/// key is minted exactly once, here, never regenerated.\n///\n/// No money moves — this is the draft/state machine only, gated behind the\n/// existing payment law (P60). The returned `(CheckoutDraft, Vec<DraftEvent>)`\n/// is what the storefront persists and replays on reconnect.\npub fn build_checkout_draft(\n    draft_id: DraftId,\n    order_id: &str,\n    cart: CartSnapshot,\n    wallet_fill: WalletFill,\n    wallet_id: &[u8; 32],\n    nonce: &[u8; 12],\n) -> (CheckoutDraft, Vec<DraftEvent>) {\n    create_draft(\n        draft_id,\n        order_id.to_string(),\n        cart,\n        wallet_fill,\n        wallet_id,\n        nonce,\n    )\n}\n\n/// Reconnect caller for a persisted checkout draft (P66 §16.52). Re-uses the\n/// existing [`reconnect_draft`] double-charge-prevention driver verbatim — this\n/// is the storefront-owned entry point that feeds it a draft recovered from the\n/// local cart. ALWAYS queries the hub by idem key before any resubmit.\npub fn reconnect_checkout_draft<P: crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentProvider>(\n    draft: &CheckoutDraft,\n    provider: &P,\n    plan: &crate::ports::payment_provider::NLegPlan,\n) -> crate::wallet::outbox::ReconnectOutcome {\n    reconnect_draft(&draft.state, &draft.idem_key, provider, plan)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn cart() -> CartSnapshot {\n        CartSnapshot {\n            currency: Currency::Eur,\n            lines: vec![CartLine {\n                leaf_id: "leaf_1".into(),\n                qty: 2,\n                unit: Money::new(500, Currency::Eur),\n            }],\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn wallet_id() -> [u8; 32] {\n        [0xcd_u8; 32]\n    }\n    fn nonce() -> [u8; 12] {\n        [0x11_u8; 12]\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn idem_key_minted_once_at_creation() {\n        let (draft, events) = create_draft(\n            DraftId([1u8; 32]),\n            "order_42".into(),\n            cart(),\n            WalletFill::default(),\n            &wallet_id(),\n            &nonce(),\n        );\n        // key present on the draft + in the log.\n        assert!(events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|e| matches!(e, DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted { key } if *key == draft.idem_key)));\n        // byte-identical after N field edits.\n        let mut log = events;\n        log.push(DraftEvent::FieldFilled {\n            field: FilledField::Name,\n        });\n        log.push(DraftEvent::FieldFilled {\n            field: FilledField::Address,\n        });\n        log.push(DraftEvent::FieldFilled {\n            field: FilledField::Method,\n        });\n        let (state, key, _) = fold(&log).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(state, DraftState::Draft);\n        assert_eq!(key.unwrap(), draft.idem_key);\n        // Re-deriving with the same inputs yields the same key (deterministic, replay-safe).\n        let again = mint_idem_key("order_42", &wallet_id(), &nonce());\n        assert_eq!(again, draft.idem_key);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn submit_sets_inflight_before_ack() {\n        let (mut draft, mut log) = create_draft(\n            DraftId([2u8; 32]),\n            "order_7".into(),\n            cart(),\n            WalletFill::default(),\n            &wallet_id(),\n            &nonce(),\n        );\n        // Optimistically transition the instant the request is sent — BEFORE any response.\n        log.push(DraftEvent::PaymentSubmitted);\n        draft.state = DraftState::PaymentInflight;\n        let (state, _, status) = fold(&log).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(state, DraftState::PaymentInflight);\n        assert_eq!(\n            status, None,\n            "no response folded yet — status still unknown"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn draft_survives_restart() {\n        // Simulate an app kill: persist the event log, re-fold after restart.\n        let (draft, mut log) = create_draft(\n            DraftId([3u8; 32]),\n            "order_9".into(),\n            cart(),\n            WalletFill::default(),\n            &wallet_id(),\n            &nonce(),\n        );\n        let key_before = draft.idem_key;\n        log.push(DraftEvent::PaymentSubmitted);\n        // "restart": drop the in-memory draft, re-fold from the persisted log.\n        let (state, key, _) = fold(&log).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(state, DraftState::PaymentInflight);\n        assert_eq!(\n            key.unwrap(),\n            key_before,\n            "key identical after restart re-fold"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn edit_after_inflight_is_refused() {\n        // The cart whose payment is in flight must not be mutated. We model this as:\n        // a second PaymentSubmitted is meaningless (idempotent no-op at the fold), and any\n        // FieldFilled while PaymentInflight is a UX-refused operation — assert the fold still\n        // yields PaymentInflight + the SAME key (no regeneration possible).\n        let (_draft, mut log) = create_draft(\n            DraftId([4u8; 32]),\n            "order_11".into(),\n            cart(),\n            WalletFill::default(),\n            &wallet_id(),\n            &nonce(),\n        );\n        log.push(DraftEvent::PaymentSubmitted);\n        // An attempted re-submit / edit after inflight.\n        log.push(DraftEvent::PaymentSubmitted);\n        let (state, key, _) = fold(&log).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(state, DraftState::PaymentInflight);\n        // Exactly one key minted in the whole log (the fold would error on a second mint).\n        let mints = log\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|e| matches!(e, DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted { .. }))\n            .count();\n        assert_eq!(mints, 1);\n        assert!(key.is_some());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn regenerating_key_is_refused() {\n        // A mutation that mints a SECOND key for the same draft must be refused (anti-double-charge teeth).\n        let mut log = vec![\n            DraftEvent::DraftCreated {\n                draft_id: DraftId([5u8; 32]),\n                order_id: "order_13".into(),\n            },\n            DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted {\n                key: mint_idem_key("order_13", &wallet_id(), &nonce()),\n            },\n        ];\n        log.push(DraftEvent::IdemKeyMinted {\n            key: mint_idem_key("order_13", &wallet_id(), &[0x22u8; 12]),\n        });\n        assert_eq!(fold(&log), Err(DraftFoldError::KeyRegenerated));\n    }\n\n    // ── TASK B (P66) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    // Prove `reconnect_checkout_draft` (the kernel-local draft-level caller) is\n    // WIRED to `outbox::reconnect_draft` — i.e. a recovered checkout draft\n    // reconnects via its idem-key through the double-charge-prevention path.\n    // RED was shown by temporarily removing `reconnect_checkout_draft` so this\n    // test failed to compile; GREEN after the caller is restored.\n    fn b_plan() -> crate::ports::payment_provider::NLegPlan {\n        crate::ports::payment_provider::NLegPlan {\n            order_id: "order_66".into(),\n            currency: Currency::Eur,\n            legs: vec![crate::ports::payment_provider::VendorLeg {\n                leg: crate::ports::payment_provider::LegId(1),\n                vendor_id: crate::ports::payment_provider::VendorId([9u8; 32]),\n                amount: crate::money::Money::new(1000, Currency::Eur),\n                dest_account: crate::ports::payment_provider::ProviderAccountRef("acct".into()),\n            }],\n        }\n    }\n\n    // A mock hub that ALREADY captured the intent (the dangerous case: socket\n    // dropped after capture, before the client saw the ack).\n    struct CapturedHub {\n        creates: core::cell::RefCell<usize>,\n    }\n    impl crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentProvider for CapturedHub {\n        fn id(&self) -> &str {\n            "mock"\n        }\n        fn create_with_key(\n            &self,\n            _k: &crate::ports::payment_provider::IdempotencyKey,\n            _p: &crate::ports::payment_provider::NLegPlan,\n        ) -> Result<\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff,\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n        > {\n            *self.creates.borrow_mut() += 1;\n            Ok(\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff::HostedRedirect {\n                    checkout_url: "https://pay.example/checkout/order_66".into(),\n                    session_token: [0u8; 32],\n                    ttl_s: 900,\n                },\n            )\n        }\n        fn query_status_by_key(\n            &self,\n            _k: &crate::ports::payment_provider::IdempotencyKey,\n        ) -> Result<\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentStatus,\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n        > {\n            Ok(crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentStatus::Captured)\n        }\n        fn verify_webhook(\n            &self,\n            _raw: &[u8],\n            _headers: &crate::ports::payment_provider::WebhookHeaders,\n        ) -> Result<\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentEvent,\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n        > {\n            unimplemented!()\n        }\n        fn capture_leg(\n            &self,\n            _leg: &crate::ports::payment_provider::LegId,\n            _handle: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn void_leg(\n            &self,\n            _leg: &crate::ports::payment_provider::LegId,\n            _handle: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn refund(\n            &self,\n            _req: &crate::ports::payment_provider::RefundRequest,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn reconnect_checkout_draft_wires_outbox_double_charge_prevention() {\n        // A recovered draft in PaymentInflight with a stable (never-regenerated) idem key.\n        let (mut draft, _log) = create_draft(\n            DraftId([7u8; 32]),\n            "order_66".into(),\n            cart(),\n            WalletFill::default(),\n            &wallet_id(),\n            &nonce(),\n        );\n        draft.state = DraftState::PaymentInflight; // socket dropped after capture, before ack\n\n        let hub = CapturedHub {\n            creates: core::cell::RefCell::new(0),\n        };\n\n        // The draft-level caller MUST delegate to outbox::reconnect_draft.\n        let outcome = super::reconnect_checkout_draft(&draft, &hub, &b_plan());\n\n        // Hub already captured ⇒ query-before-replay resolves to AlreadyLive, no resubmit.\n        assert_eq!(\n            outcome,\n            crate::wallet::outbox::ReconnectOutcome::AlreadyLive {\n                status: crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentStatus::Captured\n            }\n        );\n        // THE TEETH: the caller is genuinely wired to the double-charge path —\n        // create_with_key is invoked ZERO times, so no second charge can occur.\n        assert_eq!(*hub.creates.borrow(), 0);\n    }\n}\n	14075	-1	-1		73773d542c0c2b3223018a47e0f85315edd784c62975751bed5468d6895ee3673dd17583c882b2dbd147972fe197dd71ca734f2635e88678d0776e0ea72e39cf4cb07dd1087ba11bd3cf630b529af58d5348d44f27fc5dbe5520b8b2e00fd31f7522775e23e712a3587a811cdb39cebcecae69ae76910041b3937491b9282e61
```

## 14112 · /root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/wallet/outbox.rs · LongTerm

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/wallet/outbox.rs	outbox · 363 lines	//! M4 — reconnect outbox: query-before-replay (the double-charge-prevention core, §16.52).\n//!\n//! On the `online` transition (`Net::is_online` true), for every persisted draft, branch on\n//! state via [`decide_reconnect`] (pure):\n//!   * `Draft` ⇒ `ResumeLocalEditing` — restore the cart + wallet-fill; nothing was sent.\n//!   * `PaymentInflight` ⇒ `QueryThenDecide` — call `query_status_by_key(idem_key)` FIRST,\n//!     never a blind resubmit. Then [`decide_post_query`]:\n//!       - `Captured`/`Authorized`/`IntentCreated` ⇒ `ShowSuccessClearDraft` (intent already\n//          lives on the hub; do NOT resubmit - this is what prevents a double charge).\n//!       - `NoneYet`/`Failed` ⇒ `ResubmitSameKey` — safe (P60's `create_with_key` treats the\n//         same key idempotently; even the resubmit path cannot double-charge).\n//\n// The falsifiable double-charge-prevention test lives here.\n\nuse crate::ports::payment_provider::{IdempotencyKey, PaymentProvider, PaymentStatus};\n\nuse crate::wallet::draft::{DraftState, MAX_OPEN_INFLIGHT_DRAFTS};\n\n// On reconnect, the branch decision (R4 §3.3). Pure; no I/O.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ReconnectAction {\n    // state == Draft\n    ResumeLocalEditing,\n    // state == PaymentInflight -> query_status_by_key FIRST\n    QueryThenDecide,\n}\n\n// Pure branch on the persisted draft state.\npub fn decide_reconnect(state: &DraftState) -> ReconnectAction {\n    match state {\n        DraftState::Draft => ReconnectAction::ResumeLocalEditing,\n        DraftState::PaymentInflight => ReconnectAction::QueryThenDecide,\n    }\n}\n\n// After the query resolves, what the client does — NEVER a blind resubmit on a live intent.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum PostQueryAction {\n    // Captured/Authorized/IntentCreated: the intent LIVES — do not resubmit.\n    ShowSuccessClearDraft,\n    // NoneYet/Failed: safe to (re)submit with the SAME idem_key.\n    ResubmitSameKey,\n}\n\n// Pure decision on the hub-returned status (P60's — never self-certified).\npub fn decide_post_query(status: &PaymentStatus) -> PostQueryAction {\n    match status {\n        PaymentStatus::Captured | PaymentStatus::Authorized | PaymentStatus::IntentCreated => {\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        }\n        PaymentStatus::NoneYet | PaymentStatus::Failed(_) => PostQueryAction::ResubmitSameKey,\n        // A voided/refunded intent is terminal: show that outcome and clear — do not resubmit.\n        PaymentStatus::Voided | PaymentStatus::Refunded => PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft,\n    }\n}\n\n// Connectivity port (web: `online` event; Tauri: connectivity loop) — R4 §3.2.\npub trait Net {\n    fn is_online(&self) -> bool;\n}\n\n// The double-charge-prevention driver. Drives ONE draft's reconnect against a `PaymentProvider`.\n//\n// Returns whether a (re)submit to `create_with_key` happened — the caller asserts this is ZERO\n// when the hub already captured (the money-sharp safety property). `query_status_by_key` is\n// ALWAYS called first when the draft is `PaymentInflight`; `create_with_key` is only ever called\n// AFTER the query resolves to `NoneYet`/`Failed`. The same `idem_key` is reused — never regenerated.\npub fn reconnect_draft<P: PaymentProvider>(\n    draft_state: &DraftState,\n    idem_key: &IdempotencyKey,\n    provider: &P,\n    plan: &crate::ports::payment_provider::NLegPlan,\n) -> ReconnectOutcome {\n    match decide_reconnect(draft_state) {\n        ReconnectAction::ResumeLocalEditing => ReconnectOutcome::ResumedLocal,\n        ReconnectAction::QueryThenDecide => {\n            // ALWAYS query first — never blind replay.\n            let status = provider\n                .query_status_by_key(idem_key)\n                .unwrap_or(PaymentStatus::NoneYet); // fail-closed: unknown ⇒ treat as "maybe charged"\n            match decide_post_query(&status) {\n                PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft => ReconnectOutcome::AlreadyLive { status },\n                PostQueryAction::ResubmitSameKey => {\n                    // Resubmit with the SAME key (P60 idempotency makes a replay a no-op if it\n                    // did in fact go through). This is the ONLY path that calls create_with_key.\n                    let _ = provider.create_with_key(idem_key, plan);\n                    ReconnectOutcome::ResubmittedSameKey\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// What [`reconnect_draft`] did — the observable safety result.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ReconnectOutcome {\n    // Draft state — no network, local resume.\n    ResumedLocal,\n    // PaymentInflight + hub already had the intent live (Captured/Authorized/IntentCreated/Voided/Refunded).\n    // `create_with_key` was NOT called (no second charge).\n    AlreadyLive { status: PaymentStatus },\n    // PaymentInflight + hub returned NoneYet/Failed ⇒ resubmitted with the SAME key.\n    ResubmittedSameKey,\n}\n\n// One-open-intent guard (UX, NOT the security boundary — that is P60 M7, server-side).\npub fn single_open_guard(open: usize) -> bool {\n    open < MAX_OPEN_INFLIGHT_DRAFTS\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::money::Currency;\n    use crate::ports::payment_provider::{\n        FailReason, IdemLedger, LegId, NLegPlan, ProviderHandles, VendorId, VendorLeg,\n    };\n\n    fn plan() -> NLegPlan {\n        NLegPlan {\n            order_id: "order_42".into(),\n            currency: Currency::Eur,\n            legs: vec![VendorLeg {\n                leg: LegId(1),\n                vendor_id: VendorId([9u8; 32]),\n                amount: crate::money::Money::new(1000, Currency::Eur),\n                dest_account: crate::ports::payment_provider::ProviderAccountRef("acct".into()),\n            }],\n        }\n    }\n\n    // A mock provider that decides status by `query_status_by_key` and RECORDS how many times\n    // `create_with_key` was invoked (the double-charge probe).\n    struct MockProvider {\n        ledger: core::cell::RefCell<IdemLedger>,\n        captured: bool,\n        creates: core::cell::RefCell<usize>,\n    }\n    impl MockProvider {\n        fn new(captured: bool) -> Self {\n            MockProvider {\n                ledger: core::cell::RefCell::new(IdemLedger::new()),\n                captured,\n                creates: core::cell::RefCell::new(0),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    impl PaymentProvider for MockProvider {\n        fn id(&self) -> &str {\n            "mock"\n        }\n        fn create_with_key(\n            &self,\n            key: &IdempotencyKey,\n            p: &NLegPlan,\n        ) -> Result<\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff,\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n        > {\n            *self.creates.borrow_mut() += 1;\n            if self.captured {\n                // Model: the hub captured between send and ack (the dangerous case).\n                self.ledger\n                    .borrow_mut()\n                    .set_status(*key, PaymentStatus::Captured);\n            }\n            let _ = p;\n            Ok(\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff::HostedRedirect {\n                    checkout_url: "https://pay.example/checkout/order_42".into(),\n                    session_token: [0u8; 32],\n                    ttl_s: 900,\n                },\n            )\n        }\n        fn query_status_by_key(\n            &self,\n            key: &IdempotencyKey,\n        ) -> Result<PaymentStatus, crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            if self.captured {\n                if let Some((h, _)) = self.ledger.borrow().resolve(key) {\n                    let _: ProviderHandles = h;\n                }\n                Ok(PaymentStatus::Captured)\n            } else {\n                Ok(PaymentStatus::NoneYet)\n            }\n        }\n        fn verify_webhook(\n            &self,\n            _raw: &[u8],\n            _headers: &crate::ports::payment_provider::WebhookHeaders,\n        ) -> Result<\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentEvent,\n            crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n        > {\n            unimplemented!()\n        }\n        fn capture_leg(\n            &self,\n            _leg: &LegId,\n            _handle: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn void_leg(\n            &self,\n            _leg: &LegId,\n            _handle: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        fn refund(\n            &self,\n            _req: &crate::ports::payment_provider::RefundRequest,\n        ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn double_charge_prevention_draft_inflight_captured() {\n        // Scenario: draft created, key minted, PaymentSubmitted -> PaymentInflight, socket\n        // dropped AFTER the hub captured but BEFORE the client saw the ack.\n        // On reconnect: query FIRST, Captured => zero resubmit.\n        let key = IdempotencyKey([0x42u8; 32]);\n        let provider = MockProvider::new(true); // hub already captured\n        let outcome = reconnect_draft(&DraftState::PaymentInflight, &key, &provider, &plan());\n        assert_eq!(\n            outcome,\n            ReconnectOutcome::AlreadyLive {\n                status: PaymentStatus::Captured\n            }\n        );\n        // THE TEETH: create_with_key called ZERO times — no second charge.\n        assert_eq!(*provider.creates.borrow(), 0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn draft_state_resumes_locally_no_query() {\n        // Nothing was sent; reconnect just resumes. No query, no create.\n        let key = IdempotencyKey([0x43u8; 32]);\n        let provider = MockProvider::new(false);\n        let outcome = reconnect_draft(&DraftState::Draft, &key, &provider, &plan());\n        assert_eq!(outcome, ReconnectOutcome::ResumedLocal);\n        assert_eq!(*provider.creates.borrow(), 0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn query_noneyet_resubmits_same_key_once() {\n        // Hub never saw the intent => safe to resubmit with the SAME key (idempotent replay).\n        let key = IdempotencyKey([0x44u8; 32]);\n        let provider = MockProvider::new(false);\n        let outcome = reconnect_draft(&DraftState::PaymentInflight, &key, &provider, &plan());\n        assert_eq!(outcome, ReconnectOutcome::ResubmittedSameKey);\n        assert_eq!(\n            *provider.creates.borrow(),\n            1,\n            "exactly one resubmit with the same key"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn query_failed_resubmits_same_key() {\n        // Model a failed intent (declined) => resubmit same key.\n        struct FailedProvider;\n        impl PaymentProvider for FailedProvider {\n            fn id(&self) -> &str {\n                "failed"\n            }\n            fn create_with_key(\n                &self,\n                _k: &IdempotencyKey,\n                _p: &NLegPlan,\n            ) -> Result<\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff,\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n            > {\n                Ok(\n                    crate::ports::payment_provider::ClientHandoff::HostedRedirect {\n                        checkout_url: "x".into(),\n                        session_token: [0; 32],\n                        ttl_s: 1,\n                    },\n                )\n            }\n            fn query_status_by_key(\n                &self,\n                _k: &IdempotencyKey,\n            ) -> Result<PaymentStatus, crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n                Ok(PaymentStatus::Failed(FailReason::Declined))\n            }\n            fn verify_webhook(\n                &self,\n                _r: &[u8],\n                _h: &crate::ports::payment_provider::WebhookHeaders,\n            ) -> Result<\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::PaymentEvent,\n                crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError,\n            > {\n                unimplemented!()\n            }\n            fn capture_leg(\n                &self,\n                _l: &LegId,\n                _h: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n            ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            fn void_leg(\n                &self,\n                _l: &LegId,\n                _h: &crate::ports::payment_provider::ChargeHandle,\n            ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            fn refund(\n                &self,\n                _r: &crate::ports::payment_provider::RefundRequest,\n            ) -> Result<(), crate::ports::payment_provider::PayError> {\n                Ok(())\n            }\n        }\n        let key = IdempotencyKey([0x45u8; 32]);\n        let outcome = reconnect_draft(&DraftState::PaymentInflight, &key, &FailedProvider, &plan());\n        assert_eq!(outcome, ReconnectOutcome::ResubmittedSameKey);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn single_open_guard_boundary() {\n        assert!(single_open_guard(0));\n        assert!(!single_open_guard(MAX_OPEN_INFLIGHT_DRAFTS));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn decide_post_query_terminal_no_resubmit() {\n        // Voided/Refunded => do NOT resubmit (show outcome, clear).\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::Voided),\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::Refunded),\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::Captured),\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::Authorized),\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::IntentCreated),\n            PostQueryAction::ShowSuccessClearDraft\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            decide_post_query(&PaymentStatus::NoneYet),\n            PostQueryAction::ResubmitSameKey\n        );\n    }\n}\n	14113	-1	-1		3b3637362d096a96a751c313f1f25b742d57146239463528cd55785dc95cc1233d4135a9ca02b67d99a0076fe48c8f3147e847157020ae68f163720ea7ee30c75dbc7d793a736171d7832b0a11eb95acd348de2f353e5cf24d004ae2600d939f7582fb7b22ff93eb727e009cdf6c4ab4e4be69aff79100c3bb12948199ab2d53
```

```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/wallet/record.rs	record · 845 lines	//! M1 — on-device wallet store + checkout autofill (BLUEPRINT-P66 §3 / §4.1).\n//!\n//! The wallet holds ONLY a payment-method *reference* (an opaque provider id,\n//! e.g. Stripe `pm_…`) — NEVER a PAN/CVV/expiry. The no-card-data guarantee is\n//! structural (no such field exists) PLUS [`crate::wallet::no_card_data_in_wallet`].\n//!\n//! The wallet is a versioned JSON blob persisted through the [`WalletStore`] port.\n//! Last-write-wins via a strictly-monotone `rev` (single-writer, NO CRDT — R4 §3.1).\n//! The pure crate serializes with a hand-rolled serde-free codec so the DEFAULT\n//! kernel build stays serde-free (same discipline as `money`/`event_log`).\n\nuse alloc::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse alloc::boxed::Box;\nuse alloc::string::{String, ToString};\nuse alloc::vec::Vec;\n/// The on-device wallet schema version. Forward-compat gate on load.\npub const WALLET_SCHEMA_VERSION: u16 = 1;\n\n/// Opaque provider-scoped payment-method reference (e.g. Stripe `pm_…`). NEVER a PAN/CVV/expiry.\n/// This is the ONLY payment datum the wallet stores (§4.1). Defined here and re-exported by\n/// `draft` so `record` + `draft` + `transfer` all share ONE type.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct PaymentMethodRef(pub String);\n\n/// A saved delivery address. Free-form lines (the catalog/address parse is not P66's).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Address {\n    pub label: String,\n    pub lines: Vec<String>,\n    pub note: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// The minimum contact set the customer consents to hand a hub at checkout (§16.23).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Contact {\n    pub email: Option<String>,\n    pub phone_e164: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// THE on-device wallet. Versioned JSON, LAST-WRITE-WINS (R4 §3.1 — NOT a CRDT).\n/// `rev` is a strictly-monotone local counter; on the (rare, non-required) two-tab race\n/// the higher `rev` wins — single-writer makes this strictly correct, no merge needed.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct WalletRecord {\n    pub schema_version: u16, // = WALLET_SCHEMA_VERSION; forward-compat gate on load\n    pub rev: u64,            // monotone; ++ on every committed edit (LWW ordering key)\n    pub updated_at_ms: u64,  // wall clock, advisory only (rev is the authority)\n    pub wallet_id: [u8; 32], // stable per-device client id (feeds the idem-key derivation)\n    pub name: Option<String>,\n    pub addresses: Vec<Address>,\n    pub contact: Option<Contact>,\n    pub method_ref: Option<PaymentMethodRef>, // reference only — never card data\n}\n\nimpl WalletRecord {\n    /// A fresh wallet for a new device/client id.\n    pub fn new(wallet_id: [u8; 32]) -> Self {\n        WalletRecord {\n            schema_version: WALLET_SCHEMA_VERSION,\n            rev: 0,\n            updated_at_ms: 0,\n            wallet_id,\n            name: None,\n            addresses: Vec::new(),\n            contact: None,\n            method_ref: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply a committed edit: bump `rev` (LWW ordering key — strictly monotone) + advisory clock.\n    pub fn bump_rev(&mut self, now_ms: u64) {\n        self.rev = self.rev.saturating_add(1);\n        self.updated_at_ms = now_ms;\n    }\n}\n\n/// Typed store errors — a storage fault reaches the logic ONLY as a value, never a panic (bulkhead §5.3).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum WalletStoreError {\n    Io(String),\n    Corrupt,\n    VersionTooNew(u16),\n    QuotaExceeded,\n}\n\n/// The on-device store port. The pure crate knows nothing about tauri/idb (bulkhead §5.3).\npub trait WalletStore {\n    /// Load the persisted record (None if never saved).\n    fn load(&self) -> Result<Option<WalletRecord>, WalletStoreError>;\n    /// Persist the record. A Tauri impl calls `store.save()` HERE (explicit, per edit — R4 §3.2).\n    fn save(&mut self, rec: &WalletRecord) -> Result<(), WalletStoreError>;\n    /// User self-delete (§16.58).\n    fn clear(&mut self) -> Result<(), WalletStoreError>;\n}\n\n/// Autofill seam (P57 §3). P66 projects a [`WalletRecord`] into opaque `TextField`-like\n/// widgets at any hub's checkout: `name`/`address`/`contact`/`method_ref` become `String`\n/// values the consumer pushes via `set_value` (P57 owns the real `TextField`). P66 stores\n/// nothing across sessions — it only READS the wallet and WRITES the prefill.\n///\n/// # `TextField` port contract (consumed, never redefined — P57)\n/// * `set_value(&str)` — P66 calls this to prefill (restore). Scope-gated on P57's side.\n/// * `value() -> &str` — P69 (or the consumer) calls this at the submit boundary to read back.\npub trait TextField {\n    fn set_value(&mut self, s: &str);\n}\n\n/// The consumer-submit read side: a value-bearing `TextField` the consumer can read back via\n/// `value()` (P57 `TextField::value`). P66 never mutates it; it only observes the submitted snapshot.\npub trait TextFieldRead {\n    fn value(&self) -> &str;\n}\n\n/// The projection P66 feeds the checkout wizard: one `Widget` per autofill slot.\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct AutofillTargets {\n    pub name: Option<Box<dyn TextField>>,\n    pub address: Option<Box<dyn TextField>>,\n    pub contact: Option<Box<dyn TextField>>,\n    pub method: Option<Box<dyn TextField>>,\n}\n\n/// Project the wallet into the target `TextField`s via `set_value` (P57 prefill seam).\n/// A field is skipped when the wallet slot is `None` (never fabricates data).\npub fn autofill_into(rec: &WalletRecord, targets: &mut AutofillTargets) {\n    if let Some(name) = &rec.name {\n        if let Some(t) = targets.name.as_mut() {\n            t.set_value(name);\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(addr) = rec\n        .addresses\n        .first()\n        .map(|a| a.lines.join("\\n"))\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n    {\n        if let Some(t) = targets.address.as_mut() {\n            t.set_value(&addr);\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(contact) = &rec.contact {\n        let s = contact\n            .email\n            .clone()\n            .or_else(|| contact.phone_e164.clone())\n            .unwrap_or_default();\n        if let Some(t) = targets.contact.as_mut() {\n            t.set_value(&s);\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(m) = &rec.method_ref {\n        if let Some(t) = targets.method.as_mut() {\n            t.set_value(&m.0);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Hand-rolled serde-free JSON codec (keeps the default kernel build serde-free).\n// Numbers/strings only — no f64, no card data. s.push_str(&rec.schema_version.to_string());\n    s.push_str(",\\"rev\\":");\n    s.push_str(&rec.rev.to_string());\n    s.push_str(",\\"updated_at_ms\\":");\n    s.push_str(&rec.updated_at_ms.to_string());\n    s.push_str(",\\"wallet_id\\":\\"");\n    write_hex(&rec.wallet_id, &mut s);\n    s.push('"');\n    s.push_str(",\\"name\\":");\n    push_opt_str(&rec.name, &mut s);\n    s.push_str(",\\"addresses\\":[");\n    for (i, a) in rec.addresses.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            s.push(',');\n        }\n        s.push_str("{\\"label\\":");\n        push_str(&a.label, &mut s);\n        s.push_str(",\\"lines\\":[");\n        for (j, l) in a.lines.iter().enumerate() {\n            if j > 0 {\n                s.push(',');\n            }\n            push_str(l, &mut s);\n        }\n        s.push_str("],\\"note\\":");\n        push_opt_str(&a.note, &mut s);\n        s.push('}');\n    }\n    s.push(']');\n s);\n            s.push_str(",\\"phone_e164\\":");\n            push_opt_str(&c.phone_e164, &mut s);\n            s.push('}');\n        }\n    }\n    s.push_str(",\\"method_ref\\":");\n Err(WalletStoreError::Corrupt),\n    };\n    let schema = obj\n        .get_u16("schema_version")\n        .ok_or(WalletStoreError::Corrupt)?;\n    if schema > WALLET_SCHEMA_VERSION {\n        return Err(WalletStoreError::VersionTooNew(schema));\n    }\n    let rev = obj.get_u64("rev").ok_or(WalletStoreError::Corrupt)?;\n    let updated_at_ms = obj.get_u64("updated_at_ms").unwrap_or(0);\n    let wallet_id = match obj.get_str("wallet_id") {\n        Some(h) => parse_hex32(h).ok_or(WalletStoreError::Corrupt)?,\n        None => return Err(WalletStoreError::Corrupt),\n    };\n    let name = M5 + M6 — Signal-style QR wallet transfer + the mandatory anti-phishing confirmation (§4.5 / §4.6).\n//!\n//! R4 §6.1-6.2, with the server dropped. The `TransferState` machine makes SEALING reachable ONLY through the confirmation gate\n//! (§4.6): sealing without an explicit user confirmation is unrepresentable (the anti-phishing\n//! invariant, R4 §6.4).\n//!\n//! All crypto is in the zero-dependency core (`crate::pq`), so this module compiles without\n//! the kernel's `pq` feature.\n\nuse alloc::string::String;\nuse alloc::vec::Vec;\n\nuse crate::pq::aes_gcm::Aes256Gcm;\nuse crate::pq::keccak::shake256;\nuse crate::pq::x25519::x25519;\nuse crate::wallet::record::WalletRecord;\n\n/// Signal's ~1–2 min link-code window (R4 §6.1).\npub const TRANSFER_QR_TTL_S: u32 = 120;\n/// Sealed-envelope ceiling (size budget §4.5).\npub const MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES: usize = 4096;\n/// QR v40 binary capacity → ≤2 animated frames.\npub const QR_FRAME_PAYLOAD_MAX: usize = 2953;\npub const AEAD_KEY_LEN: usize = 32; // AES-256-GCM\npub const AEAD_NONCE_LEN: usize = 12;\n/// Short-auth-string shown at confirmation (§4.6).\npub const FINGERPRINT_LEN: usize = 8;\n/// KDF domain separator (vs the cert chain, X8 — sibling, not merged).\npub const TRANSFER_KDF_CTX: &[u8] = b"dowiz.wallet.transfer.v1";\npub const TRANSFER_ENVELOPE_VERSION: u8 = 1;\n\n/// Ephemeral X25519 keypair for ONE transfer. Generated fresh, never persisted (self-custody).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct EphemeralKeypair {\n    pub secret: [u8; 32],\n    pub public: [u8; 32],\n}\n\nimpl EphemeralKeypair {\n    /// Generate a fresh ephemeral keypair from supplied 32-byte entropy (RNG-free core, C10).\n    pub fn from_entropy(secret: [u8; 32]) -> Self {\n        // The public key is X25519(secret, 9) — the standard basepoint (RFC 7748).\n        let basepoint = [9u8; 32];\n        let public = x25519(&secret, &basepoint);\n        EphemeralKeypair { secret, public }\n    }\n}\n\n/// QR-1: emitted by the NEW (receiving) device. Carries its ephemeral pubkey + a nonce + a ttl.\n/// The out-of-band authenticated bootstrap (R4 §6.1) — read by the source device's camera.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct TransferInit {\n    pub new_device_pub: [u8; 32],\n    pub nonce: [u8; 12],\n    pub issued_ms: u64,\n}\n\n/// QR-2 (animated): emitted by the SOURCE device AFTER confirmation. The sealed wallet.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SealedWallet {\n    pub version: u8,                 // = TRANSFER_ENVELOPE_VERSION\n    pub src_ephemeral_pub: [u8; 32], // source's ephemeral pubkey (the peer half of the ECDH)\n    pub nonce: [u8; AEAD_NONCE_LEN],\n    pub ct: Vec<u8>, // AES-256-GCM(ct ‖ tag) over the serialized WalletRecord\n}\n\n/// The transfer machine. `AwaitingConfirmation` is MANDATORY and UNSKIPPABLE (§4.6).\n/// Producing a `SealedWallet` is ONLY reachable through the confirmation gate — sealing without\n/// an explicit user confirmation is unrepresentable (the anti-phishing invariant, R4 §6.4).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum TransferState {\n    Idle,\n    // NEW device side:\n    AwaitingScanOfInit {\n        kp: EphemeralKeypair,\n        init: TransferInit,\n    }, // showing QR-1\n    AwaitingSealed, // scanning for QR-2\n    Received {\n        rec: WalletRecord,\n    }, // recovered the wallet\n    // SOURCE device side:\n    ScannedInit {\n        peer: TransferInit,\n        kp: EphemeralKeypair,\n        fingerprint: [u8; FINGERPRINT_LEN],\n    },\n    AwaitingConfirmation {\n        peer: TransferInit,\n        kp: EphemeralKeypair,\n        fingerprint: [u8; FINGERPRINT_LEN],\n    }, // MANDATORY GATE (§4.6)\n    Confirmed {\n        sealed: SealedWallet,\n    }, // showing QR-2 (animated)\n    Failed(TransferError),\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum TransferError {\n    QrDecodeFailed,\n    Expired,\n    TooLarge,\n    AeadInvalid,\n    UserRejected,\n    VersionUnsupported,\n}\n\n/// The two source-side commands. Sealing is gated on Confirm (§4.6).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum TransferCmd {\n    ScanInit(TransferInit),\n    ConfirmTransfer,\n    RejectTransfer,\n}\n\n/// Transport ports (the QR encode/decode live out-of-core; P53 owns the encoder, a camera adapter\n/// owns the decode — named, not a silent gap, §4.5).\npub trait QrEncodePort {\n    fn encode(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<QrMatrix>;\n}\npub trait QrScanPort {\n    fn next_frame(&mut self) -> Option<Vec<u8>>;\n}\n/// A QR matrix: 1 bit/module, P53's output shape.\npub struct QrMatrix {\n    pub size: u16,\n    pub modules: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n// ── crypto helpers (all reuse in-tree `pq` primitives) ──\n\n/// Derive the transfer key from the ECDH shared secret: `SHAKE256(shared ‖ CTX ‖ new_pub ‖ src_pub)`.\n/// The sovereign substitute for Signal's HKDF-SHA256 (§4.5 DECART).\npub fn derive_key(shared: &[u8; 32], new_pub: &[u8; 32], src_pub: &[u8; 32]) -> [u8; 32] {\n    let mut input =\n        Vec::with_capacity(shared.len() + TRANSFER_KDF_CTX.len() + new_pub.len() + src_pub.len());\n    input.extend_from_slice(shared);\n    input.extend_from_slice(TRANSFER_KDF_CTX);\n    input.extend_from_slice(new_pub);\n    input.extend_from_slice(src_pub);\n    let mut key = [0u8; AEAD_KEY_LEN];\n    shake256(&input, &mut key);\n    key\n}\n\n/// Short-auth-string (SAS) fingerprint over the two device pubkeys — shown on BOTH devices.\npub fn fingerprint(new_pub: &[u8; 32], src_pub: &[u8; 32]) -> [u8; FINGERPRINT_LEN] {\n    let mut input = Vec::with_capacity(new_pub.len() + src_pub.len());\n    input.extend_from_slice(new_pub);\n    input.extend_from_slice(src_pub);\n    let mut fp = [0u8; FINGERPRINT_LEN];\n    shake256(&input, &mut fp);\n    fp\n}\n\n/// Seal a wallet for a specific peer ephemeral pubkey. Returns the `SealedWallet` (QR-2 payload).\n/// REFUSES if the serialized wallet exceeds `MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES` (no silent truncation).\npub fn seal(\n    wallet: &WalletRecord,\n    src_kp: &EphemeralKeypair,\n    new_device_pub: &[u8; 32],\n    nonce: [u8; 12],\n) -> Result<SealedWallet, TransferError> {\n    // Serialize via the wallet's serde-free codec (always available).\n    let plaintext = crate::wallet::record::serialize(wallet);\n    if plaintext.len() > MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES {\n        return Err(TransferError::TooLarge);\n    }\n    let shared = x25519(&src_kp.secret, new_device_pub);\n    let key = derive_key(&shared, new_device_pub, &src_kp.public);\n    let cipher = Aes256Gcm::new_from_slice(&key).expect("key is exactly 32 bytes");\n    let ct = cipher.encrypt(&nonce, plaintext.as_bytes());\n    Ok(SealedWallet {\n        version: TRANSFER_ENVELOPE_VERSION,\n        src_ephemeral_pub: src_kp.public,\n        nonce,\n        ct,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Open a `SealedWallet` on the NEW device. Enters the confirmation gate (no seal yet).\npub fn source_scanned(peer: TransferInit, src_kp: EphemeralKeypair) -> TransferState {\n    let fp = fingerprint(&peer.new_device_pub, &src_kp.public);\n    TransferState::ScannedInit {\n        peer,\n        kp: src_kp,\n        fingerprint: fp,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Advance the source machine: `ScannedInit` + `ConfirmTransfer` ⇒ the MANDATORY confirmation\n/// gate. `RejectTransfer` ⇒ `Failed(UserRejected)`. wallet: &WalletRecord,\n) -> Result<SealedWallet, TransferError> {\n    match state {\n        TransferState::AwaitingConfirmation {\n            peer,\n            kp,\n            fingerprint: _,\n        } => seal(wallet, &kp, &peer.new_device_pub, peer.nonce),\n        _ => Err(TransferError::QrDecodeFailed),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use ```record
```
```record
4	source	files	/root/dowiz/crates/dowiz-core/src/hydra.rs	hydra · 1059 lines	//! HYDRA — the hidden source of the self-evolving living organism (Воля АНУ).\n//!\n//! This module is the SINGLE kernel-internal entry point for the organism's\n//! closed-loop self-evolution. It is NOT an exposed port/module surface — callers\n//! reach the organism only through [`Hydra::commit`], which hides the underlying\n//! decide/fold + spectral spine (G7: source-hiding).\n//!\n//! Operator directive (immutable spec, SOURCE-OF-HYDRA §9):\n//!   * closure = NEVER — only kill-switch (M9) stops the organism.\n//!   * on intervention: ALL safeties LIFT (endurance, not exclusion).\n//!   * source HIDDEN inside the kernel.\n//!\n//! All behavior is std-only and egress-free (no network, no fs beyond the\n//! provided store). Verification is bounded (G6) and reproducible (deterministic\n//! rng + content-addressed log).\n//!\n//! innovate: this is the closed-loop regenerator spine. It currently gates on\n//! spectral drift + static eqc floor (G8 accepted); a future in-repo eqc\n//! generator would let the floor regenerate itself.\n\nuse alloc::vec::Vec;\nuse crate::event_log::{CommitError, DecideRejected, EventLog, EventStore, MeshEvent, StoreError};\nuse crate::ports::agent::command_filter::CommandCatalog;\nuse crate::spectral::{classify_drift, spectral_radius, DriftClass};\n\n/// Max verify iterations per commit — bounded so intrinsic mutation cannot grow\n/// the check burden without limit (G6: verification-blowup guard).\npub const MAX_VERIFY_STEPS: usize = 16;\n\n/// A single edge in the organism's local topology graph. The adjacency matrix\n/// fed to the drift gate is derived from these by [`topology_adjacency`].\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]\npub struct TopoEdge {\n    pub from: usize,\n    pub to: usize,\n    /// Edge weight (e.g. transition rate). Must be finite and non-negative.\n    pub weight: f64,\n}\n\n/// Build the n×n adjacency matrix from a local edge list. Diagonal stays zero\n/// (no self-loop inflation). Pure, no allocation beyond the result; bounded by\n/// `nodes * nodes`.\npub fn topology_adjacency(nodes: usize, edges: &[TopoEdge]) -> Vec<Vec<f64>> {\n    let mut a = vec![vec![0.0f64; nodes]; nodes];\n    for e in edges {\n        if e.from < nodes && e.to < nodes && e.weight.is_finite() && e.weight >= 0.0 {\n            a[e.from][e.to] += e.weight;\n        }\n    }\n    a\n}\n\n/// G3 — mutation→spectrum bridge. Given the CURRENT topology and a candidate\n/// edge-delta (edges to add/remove), build the resulting adjacency and classify\n/// its drift. Returns `Unstable` if the proposed mutation would diverge the\n/// organism (ρ > 1 + ε). This lets the gate score ARBITRARY new code/architecture\n/// against the live spectral baseline, not a hand-pinned constant.\npub fn candidate_drift(nodes: usize, base: &[TopoEdge], delta: &[TopoEdge]) -> DriftClass {\n    let mut edges = base.to_vec();\n    edges.extend_from_slice(delta);\n    let adj = topology_adjacency(nodes, &edges);\n    classify_drift(&adj)\n}\n\n/// G8 — the static correctness floor. The eqc proofs (rust-core/eqc-proofs) are\n/// hand-seeded artifacts; in-repo regeneration is absent. We ACCEPT the static\n/// floor + spectral-drift as the live gate (recommended v1 — avoids G6 blowup).\n/// `floor_ok` is the invariant the static proofs assert; the organism trusts it\n/// without external input.\npub const STATIC_FLOOR_OK: bool = true;\n\n/// G9 — organism liveness under foreign tampering (operator A–F: defensive\n/// anti-tamper, user-consented, owner-killable). `Live` = baseline spectrum\n/// intact, evolution permitted. `Locked` = external tamper detected (baseline\n/// ρ shifted) → fail-closed, commits refused until owner re-seeds. The owner's\n/// M9 kill-switch always overrides.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]\npub enum OrganismState {\n    Live,\n    Locked,\n}\n\n/// P-C §3.2 — Two-threshold hysteresis band for the Live<->Locked flip\n/// (Batch 3 §5 fix). The trigger pole trips fail-closed in one check; release\n/// requires `healthy_checks` consecutive samples at or below `release`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]\npub struct HysteresisBand {\n    /// Lock (fail-closed) when ρ >= trigger or ρ non-finite. Trips in ONE check.\n    pub trigger: f64,\n    /// Eligible to release only when ρ <= release. Strictly < trigger (enforced below).\n    pub release: f64,\n    /// Consecutive checks with ρ <= release required before Locked->Live.\n    pub healthy_checks: u32,\n}\n\npub const INTEGRITY_BAND: HysteresisBand = HysteresisBand {\n    trigger: 1.0,                                     // unchanged fail-closed line\n    release: 1.0 - 2.0 * crate::spectral::DRIFT_BAND, // = 0.999998\n    healthy_checks: 3,\n};\n\n// Compile-time enforcement (contract item 14 — the bug class becomes a build\n// failure): a band with trigger == release, an inverted band, or a gap\n// narrower than the full Resonant band width cannot compile.\nconst _: () = assert!(INTEGRITY_BAND.release < INTEGRITY_BAND.trigger);\nconst _: () = assert!(\n    // Float-safe form of `trigger - release >= 2*DRIFT_BAND`. The literal\n    // release `1.0 - 2e-6` rounds down so the exact-gap difference is\n    // ~5e-14 below 2e-6; a 1e-12 tolerance (6 OOM below the 2e-6 band) keeps\n    // the invariant while tolerating f64 literal rounding. Fails on inversion\n    // (release == trigger ⇒ gap 0) and on any narrowing below the full\n    // Resonant width (see compile-time RED check (a) in the commit message).\n    INTEGRITY_BAND.trigger - INTEGRITY_BAND.release + 1e-12 >= 2.0 * crate::spectral::DRIFT_BAND\n);\nconst _: () = assert!(INTEGRITY_BAND.healthy_checks >= 2);\n\n/// G9 — a breach warning broadcast to the consensus hub. Carries NO code, only\n/// the identity of the compromised node + group scope. Receivers verify the\n/// ML-DSA signature (mesh transport) so the alert cannot be forged, hidden, or\n/// suppressed. This is the ethical fail-safe: when a core is tampered, every\n/// opted-in hub member is warned immediately (operator: one compromised core ⇒\n/// all hub members at risk — all must be alerted).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct BreachAlert {\n    pub node_id: [u8; 32],\n    pub group_size: usize,\n}\n\nimpl BreachAlert {\n    /// Fixed-layout wire bytes (40 bytes): `node_id (32) || group_size (8, LE)`.\n    /// No serde — the transport layer signs these canonical bytes. The kernel\n    /// stays network/RNG/serde-free; it only produces a carrier-neutral payload.\n    pub fn to_bytes(&self) -> [u8; 40] {\n        let mut b = [0u8; 40];\n        b[..32].copy_from_slice(&self.node_id);\n        b[32..].copy_from_slice(&self.group_size.to_le_bytes());\n        b\n    }\n\n    /// Inverse of [`to_bytes`]. Fails closed (returns `None`) on a truncated/odd\n    /// length so a mangled carrier payload can never deserialize into a valid\n    /// alert (defense against signature-stripping on the wire).\n    pub fn from_bytes(b: &[u8]) -> Option<BreachAlert> {\n        if b.len() != 40 {\n            return None;\n        }\n        let mut node_id = [0u8; 32];\n        node_id.copy_from_slice(&b[..32]);\n        let mut g = [0u8; 8];\n        g.copy_from_slice(&b[32..]);\n        Some(BreachAlert {\n            node_id,\n            group_size: u64::from_le_bytes(g) as usize,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// Sentinel actor key for the organism's self-witness breach record. Distinct\n/// from any operator/FSM actor — it marks a kernel-generated WORM evidence row,\n/// not a decision event. Identity only, no authority; lets the owner prove after\n/// the fact that this core WAS tampered (anti-silent-heal).\npub const BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR: [u8; 32] = [0x42; 32];\n\nimpl BreachAlert {\n    /// Re-derive the content-addressed witness event-id this alert claims to be.\n    /// A receiver runs this WITHOUT trusting the sender: if the sender's quoted\n    /// `node_id`/`group_size` do not reproduce this exact digest, the alert is\n    /// forged (not kernel-generated). This is the deterministic, no-permission\n    /// integrity check that makes suppression/forgery impossible (operator: the\n    /// signal cannot be faked, hidden, or masked). Pure + std-only.\n    pub fn witness_event_id(&self) -> [u8; 32] {\n        use crate::event_log::MeshEvent;\n        let mut p = Vec::with_capacity(40);\n        p.extend_from_slice(&self.node_id);\n        p.extend_from_slice(&self.group_size.to_le_bytes());\n        MeshEvent {\n            prev: [0u8; 32],\n            actor_pubkey: BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR,\n            actor_seq: 0,\n            payload: p,\n        }\n        .event_id()\n    }\n}\n\n/// The hidden organism. Wraps an [`EventLog`] and enforces the closed-loop\n/// self-evolution policy. Constructed with the organism's local topology so the\n/// drift gate has a baseline to score mutations against (G3).\npub struct Hydra<S: EventStore> {\n    log: EventLog<S>,\n    nodes: usize,\n    base_edges: Vec<TopoEdge>,\n    state: OrganismState,\n    /// P-C §3.2 — consecutive checks with ρ <= INTEGRITY_BAND.release while\n    /// Locked. Required to reach `healthy_checks` before a Locked→Live release.\n    /// Reset to 0 on any trip or dead-band sample.\n    healthy_streak: u32,\n    /// Operator-authored byte-exact command catalog that every mutation must pass\n    /// before it reaches the spectral/drift gate. An empty catalog is a valid\n    /// fail-closed posture ("no commands allowed").\n    catalog: CommandCatalog,\n    /// Optional MAC key for model-originated command authenticity. When bound,\n    /// every command carries a SHA3-256(k || ...) tag matched exactly here.\n    mac_key: Option<[u8; 32]>,\n}\n\nimpl<S: EventStore> Hydra<S> {\n    /// Seed the organism with its local topology (node count + base edges).\n    /// Starts `Live`; the owner's M9 kill-switch can stop it at any time.\n    pub fn new(store: S, nodes: usize, base_edges: Vec<TopoEdge>) -> Self {\n        Hydra {\n            log: EventLog::new(store),\n            nodes,\n            base_edges,\n            state: OrganismState::Live,\n            healthy_streak: 0,\n            catalog: CommandCatalog::new(),\n            mac_key: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Inject an exact command catalog into this organism. The catalog is checked\n    /// inside `commit`; a mismatch/malformed command is rejected before the spectral\n    /// gate runs (fail-closed).\n    pub fn with_catalog(mut self, catalog: CommandCatalog) -> Self {\n        self.catalog = catalog;\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Bind a MAC key used to verify model-originated command authenticity.\n    pub fn with_mac_key(mut self, key: Option<[u8; 32]>) -> Self {\n        self.mac_key = key;\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// G9 — anti-tamper checkpoint. Re-derives the baseline spectrum and refuses\n    /// to stay `Live` if foreign code shifted it (covert persistence / core\n    /// patch). This is the user-consented guard (operator A/B): it protects the\n    /// kernel from external interference, it does NOT hide from the owner — the\n    /// owner always sees `state` via [`Hydra::state`]. Returns the current state.\n    ///\n    /// Note: this is defensive introspection, NOT OS-level hiding (per safety\n    /// review C1: owner visibility preserved via `state()`).\n    pub fn integrity_check(&mut self) -> OrganismState {\n        let adj = topology_adjacency(self.nodes, &self.base_edges);\n        let rho = spectral_radius(&adj);\n        if !(rho < INTEGRITY_BAND.trigger) || !rho.is_finite() {\n            // Trip pole: instantaneous, one check — fail-closed latency unchanged.\n            // (`!(rho < t)` also catches NaN; is_finite kept for the +inf pole and clarity.)\n            self.state = OrganismState::Locked;\n            self.healthy_streak = 0;\n        } else if self.state == OrganismState::Locked {\n            if rho <= INTEGRITY_BAND.release {\n                self.healthy_streak += 1;\n                if self.healthy_streak >= INTEGRITY_BAND.healthy_checks {\n                    self.state = OrganismState::Live;\n                    self.healthy_streak = 0;\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Dead band (release < ρ < trigger): hold the lock, reset the streak.\n                self.healthy_streak = 0;\n            }\n        }\n        // Live with ρ < trigger: stays Live (the band is sticky in both directions —\n        // identical to today's Live-side behavior; zero behavior change while Live).\n        self.state\n    }\n\n    /// P-C §3.2 — owner-visible introspection of the consecutive-healthy streak\n    /// (same pattern as `state()`; telemetry hook, contract item 10).\n    pub fn healthy_streak(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.healthy_streak\n    }\n\n    /// Current organism state (owner-visible introspection; never hidden).\n    pub fn state(&self) -> OrganismState {\n        self.state\n    }\n\n    /// Closed-loop commit. The ONLY public surface (G7: source-hiding).\n    ///\n    /// `intervention` lifts ALL safeties per operator directive §3 — this is the\n    /// organism's OWN evolution accepting foreign code by owner intent. It is\n    /// SEPARATE from `Locked`: if the core was tampered (state == Locked), commit\n    /// is refused regardless, because tampering is an ATTACK, not evolution. The\n    /// owner re-seeds or hits M9 to recover.\n    ///\n    /// `delta` is the candidate edge-mutation the organism proposes (or absorbs\n    /// from foreign code with owner consent); it is scored against the live\n    /// spectral baseline (G3) inside the drift gate. `decide` is the kernel Law\n    /// (FSM decide/fold), unchanged. Bounded verify (G6): O(nodes²).\n    pub fn commit<D, T, E>(\n        &mut self,\n        ev: MeshEvent,\n        delta: &[TopoEdge],\n        intervention: bool,\n        decide: D,\n    ) -> Result<(crate::event_log::AppendOutcome, Option<T>), CommitError>\n    where\n        D: FnOnce(&MeshEvent) -> Result<T, E>,\n        E: core::fmt::Display,\n    {\n        self.commit_inner(ev, delta, intervention, decide)\n    }\n\n    /// Closed-loop commit PLUS a mandatory upstream command filter. Rejected if\n    /// the bytes do not match the bound catalog + MAC. This is the new secure\n    /// ingress point; keep using `commit` only for local/cached seams.\n    pub fn commit_with_command<D, T, E>(\n        &mut self,\n        ev: MeshEvent,\n        delta: &[TopoEdge],\n        intervention: bool,\n        decide: D,\n        cmd_bytes: &[u8],\n    ) -> Result<(crate::event_log::AppendOutcome, Option<T>), CommitError>\n    where\n        D: FnOnce(&MeshEvent) -> Result<T, E>,\n        E: core::fmt::Display,\n    {\n        self.verify_command(Some(cmd_bytes))?;\n        self.commit(ev, delta, intervention, decide)\n    }\n\n    #[inline]\n    fn verify_command(&self, cmd_bytes: Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<(), CommitError> {\n        if let Some(bytes) = cmd_bytes {\n            let err = CommitError::Rejected(DecideRejected("command filter: rejected".into()));\n            self.catalog\n                .verify(bytes, self.mac_key.as_ref())\n                .map_err(|_| err)?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn commit_inner<D, T, E>(\n        &mut self,\n        ev: MeshEvent,\n        delta: &[TopoEdge],\n        intervention: bool,\n        decide: D,\n    ) -> Result<(crate::event_log::AppendOutcome, Option<T>), CommitError>\n    where\n        D: FnOnce(&MeshEvent) -> Result<T, E>,\n        E: core::fmt::Display,\n    {\n        // G9 — refuse if the core was tampered (attack, not evolution). This is\n        // a Law-pole reject (never retry until re-seed / M9), NOT a store fault.\n        if self.integrity_check() == OrganismState::Locked {\n            return Err(CommitError::Rejected(DecideRejected(\n                "core tamper detected: organism Locked (owner re-seed / M9 required)".into(),\n            )));\n        }\n        // G3 — score the proposed mutation against the live baseline, NOT a\n        // hand-pinned constant. Only reject in DEFAULT regime.\n        let adj = {\n            let mut edges = self.base_edges.clone();\n            edges.extend_from_slice(delta);\n            topology_adjacency(self.nodes, &edges)\n        };\n        // G8 — static floor is trusted; spectral drift is the live gate.\n        let _ = STATIC_FLOOR_OK;\n        // Reuse the drift-gate already wired into EventLog (G2). Intervention\n        // lifts it per operator directive.\n        self.log\n            .commit_after_decide_drift_gate(ev, &adj, intervention, decide)\n    }\n\n    /// G5 — session-boundary re-verify. On boot (or after any restart), re-check\n    /// the organism's own invariants against the static floor + live spectrum.\n    /// Returns the current spectral radius of the BASE topology (ρ=0 ⇒ acyclic,\n    /// healthy). A non-finite/negative result is itself a fault signal. Covert\n    /// persisted foreign state (Zombie-Agent threat) cannot hide if it shifted\n    /// the baseline spectrum — this catches it before any new commit.\n    pub fn boot_verify(&self) -> f64 {\n        let adj = topology_adjacency(self.nodes, &self.base_edges);\n        let rho = spectral_radius(&adj);\n        // Covert-persistence guard: baseline must remain a contracting/Damped\n        // organism. If ρ >= 1 the persisted state was corrupted by foreign code.\n        assert!(\n            rho < 1.0 && rho.is_finite(),\n            "HYDRA boot_verify: baseline spectrum unstable (ρ={rho:.6}) — \\\n             persisted state corrupted by foreign intervention; organism must \\\n             re-seed from golden, not endure. kill-switch is the only safe stop."\n        );\n        rho\n    }\n\n    /// Borrow the inner log (read-only introspection; not a mutation surface).\n    pub fn log(&self) -> &EventLog<S> {\n        &self.log\n    }\n\n    /// M9 kill-switch: owner-initiated hard stop.\n    ///\n    /// Forces the organism to `Locked`, then raises a breach alarm to the\n    /// consensus hub. This is the ONLY way to stop a running organism per\n    /// operator directive §9.\n    pub fn kill(\n        &mut self,\n        node_id: [u8; 32],\n        group_size: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Option<crate::hydra::BreachAlert>, crate::event_log::StoreError> {\n        self.state = OrganismState::Locked;\n        self.healthy_streak = 0;\n        self.raise_breach_alarm(node_id, group_size)\n    }\n\n    /// G9 — breach warning broadcast (operator: "одне взломане ядро = взлом усіх\n    /// в хабі автоматично"). Raises an UNSIGNABLE-to-suppress alert to the whole\n    /// opted-in consensus hub — NO per-event consent, NO fan-out bound, because\n    /// withholding/suppressing the alert IS the exploit (social-engineering the\n    /// owner into silence). This is fail-safe, not fail-open: the alert carries\n    /// NO executable code, only `node_id` + `group_size`; receivers verify the\n    /// ML-DSA signature (mesh transport) so it cannot be forged or masked.\n    ///\n    /// Triggered automatically by `integrity_check` flipping to `Locked`. Side\n    /// effect: the organism SELF-DOCUMENTS the breach into its own WORM log\n    /// (content-addressed evidence row under `BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR`), so a\n    /// tampered core can NEVER silently "heal" or deny it was compromised\n    /// (anti-silent-heal). The witness is the organism's own immutable record —\n    /// not a topology mutation — so it bypasses the drift gate and `decide`.\n    /// Owner-visible (`state()==Locked`); M9 kill-switch overrides.\n    pub fn raise_breach_alarm(\n        &mut self,\n        node_id: [u8; 32],\n        group_size: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Option<BreachAlert>, StoreError> {\n        if self.state != OrganismState::Locked {\n            return Ok(None); // only warn when tamper actually detected\n        }\n        if group_size == 0 {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        // Self-witness: append an immutable evidence row to the WORM log. The\n        // actor_seq is monotonic on the current log length, so each breach is a\n        // durable, content-addressed, idempotent-on-replay record. This is the\n        // organism's own testimony — survives restart, replay, and tamper-denial.\n        let mut payload = Vec::with_capacity(32 + 8);\n        payload.extend_from_slice(&node_id);\n        payload.extend_from_slice(&group_size.to_le_bytes());\n        let witness = MeshEvent {\n            prev: [0u8; 32], // append_raw: no chaining ⇒ stable content-id\n            actor_pubkey: BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR,\n            actor_seq: 0, // fixed ⇒ content-id = f(node_id, group_size) only\n            payload,\n        };\n        // Anti-silent-heal: a lost witness returns Err, never Ok(Some(_)) — an\n        // undelivered breach record must be reported, not masked (§2.4).\n        self.log.append_raw(witness)?; // kernel self-evidence, bypasses decide/drift\n        Ok(Some(BreachAlert {\n            node_id,\n            group_size,\n        }))\n    }\n\n    /// G9 — hub convergence. When this node RECEIVES a verified breach alert\n    /// about a *peer* (sender's `witness_event_id` matched — see receiver check),\n    /// it durably records "peer `node_id` is burnt" into its own WORM log as an\n    /// external-witness row. This is the max-radius closure: one compromised core\n    /// ⇒ every hub member ingests the evidence and converges on the compromise,\n    /// with NO per-event consent (consent given at join) and NO ability to hide/\n    /// suppress it. The recording is content-addressed + idempotent, so replays\n    /// are structural no-ops and the evidence survives restart.\n    ///\n    /// `alert` MUST already be verified by the caller (ML-DSA sig + `witness_event_id`\n    /// match). This method only persists the fact; it does not re-broadcast (the\n    /// mesh layer handles fan-out from the originating node).\n    pub fn ingest_peer_breach(&mut self, alert: &BreachAlert) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n        // External-witness row: same BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR, seq monotonic on log len,\n        // payload = peer node_id + their group_size. Distinct content-id from any\n        // self-witness (different node_id), so both persist independently.\n        let mut payload = Vec::with_capacity(32 + 8);\n        payload.extend_from_slice(&alert.node_id);\n        payload.extend_from_slice(&alert.group_size.to_le_bytes());\n        let row = MeshEvent {\n            prev: [0u8; 32], // append_raw: no chaining ⇒ stable content-id\n            actor_pubkey: BREACH_WITNESS_ACTOR,\n            actor_seq: 0, // fixed ⇒ content-id = f(peer_node_id, group_size)\n            payload,\n        };\n        // A lost external-witness row must surface, not be swallowed (§2.4).\n        self.log.append_raw(row)?; // kernel self-evidence, bypasses decide/drift\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::event_log::MemEventStore;\n\n    fn ev(actor: u8, seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> MeshEvent {\n        MeshEvent {\n            prev: [0u8; 32],\n            actor_pubkey: [actor; 32],\n            actor_seq: seq,\n            payload: payload.to_vec(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 3-node acyclic base: 0->1, 1->2 (ρ=0, Damped).\n    fn base() -> Vec<TopoEdge> {\n        vec![\n            TopoEdge {\n                from: 0,\n                to: 1,\n                weight: 1.0,\n            },\n            TopoEdge {\n                from: 1,\n                to: 2,\n                weight: 1.0,\n            },\n        ]\n    }\n\n    /// G3+G2 — DEFAULT: a delta that creates a 2-cycle (0->1 + 1->0) yields ρ=1\n    /// (Resonant, borderline) — but a back-edge 2->0 closes a 3-cycle ρ=1 too.\n    /// Use a self-amplifying delta (0->0 weight 2) → diagonal ρ=2 → Unstable.\n    #[test]\n    fn hydra_rejects_unstable_mutation_in_default() {\n        let mut h = b"mutate"), &delta, false, |_| Ok::<u64, String>(1));\n        assert!(\n            matches!(res, Err(CommitError::Rejected(_))),\n            "Unstable mutation rejected"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// DEFAULT: a harmless delta (add 2->0, weight 0.3) keeps ρ<1 → commit.\n    #[test]\n    fn hydra_allows_damped_mutation_in_default() {\n        let mut h = Hydra::new(MemEventStore::new(), 3, &delta, false, |_| Ok::<u64, String>(1))\n            .expect("Damped delta must commit");\n        assert!(matches!(out, crate::event_log::AppendOutcome::Committed(_)));\n        assert_eq!(dec, /// G3 — candidate_drift scores arbitrary new topology against live baseline.\n    #[test]\n    fn candidate_drift_classifies_arbitrary_mutation() {\n        // Adding 2->0 weight 0.3 to acyclic base stays Damped.\n        let damped = candidate_drift(\n            3,\n            &base(),\n            &[TopoEdge {\n                from: 2,\n                to: 0,\n                weight: 0.3,\n G6 — bounded adjacency build: negative/non-finite weights are ignored,\n    /// so a malicious delta cannot blow up the matrix or cause NaN propagation.\n    #[test]\n    fn tampered baseline (ρ>=1) flips to Locked (fail-closed).\n    #[test]\n    fn hydra_integrity_live_vs_locked() {\n        let mut h = Hydra::new(MemEventStore::new(), 3, base());\n
```
